ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning VLA

Vision-Language-Action Chain-of-Dynamics world imagination human-to-robot transfer reinforcement learning

简要说明：ThinkWorld 提出了一种 VLA 框架，通过动力学链运动标记将动作推理扎根于世界动态，并利用世界想象的强化学习实现从无动作视频到机器人的有效迁移。

TLDR: ThinkWorld introduces a VLA framework that uses Chain-of-Dynamics motion tokens to ground action reasoning in world dynamics, enabling reinforcement learning with world imagination and effective human-to-robot transfer from action-free videos.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, but their generalization remains constrained by the diversity and coverage of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Human videos provide much broader behavioral and environmental experience, while learning from them faces a fundamental trade-off between scalable data and explicit action grounding. We introduce ThinkWorld, a VLA learning framework that grounds action reasoning in world dynamics and strengthens it through reinforcement learning with world imagination. ThinkWorld represents each action thought as a Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD), a sequence of discrete motion tokens that captures the intermediate dynamics connecting the current world to a future state and serves as a common action representation across embodiments. We first initialize CoD with action-labeled demonstrations, then predict the future induced by each CoD and reinforce those whose predictions better match the observed outcome. This enables videos without action annotations to provide direct supervision from observed state transitions, allowing human and robot experience to refine the same reasoning space. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate effective human-to-robot transfer and strong generalization to unseen tasks and environments.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作领域取得了显著进展，但其泛化能力仍受限于带动作标注的机器人演示数据的多样性与覆盖范围。人类视频提供了更为广泛的行为与环境经验，然而从中学习面临可扩展数据与显式动作标注之间的根本性权衡。我们提出ThinkWorld，一种VLA学习框架，将动作推理锚定于世界动力学，并通过世界想象驱动的强化学习加以增强。ThinkWorld将每个动作思维表示为动力学链（CoD），即一组离散运动标记的序列，捕捉从当前世界状态到未来状态之间的中间动力学过程，并作为跨具身形态的通用动作表示。我们首先利用带动作标注的演示数据初始化CoD，随后预测每个CoD所引发的未来状态，并强化那些预测与观测结果更匹配的CoD。这使得无动作标注的视频能够通过观测到的状态转移提供直接监督，从而使人类经验与机器人经验在同一推理空间内实现协同优化。仿真实验与真实机器人实验均验证了人类到机器人的有效迁移，以及对未见任务与环境具有较强的泛化能力。

Authors: Chaehyun Kim, Chi-Pin Huang, Jisoo Kim, Min-Hung Chen, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang, Seungryong Kim, Fu-En Yang

Pushing Dexterity and Safety for In-Hand Object Pose Reaching That Works Remarkably Well Manipulation

dexterous manipulation in-hand manipulation sim-to-real transfer safety filter LEAP hand

简要说明：本文提出了一种在仿真中训练LEAP手部进行物体位姿到达策略的方法，该策略可零样本迁移到真实手部，并实现了高成功率，同时通过学习残差安全滤波器减少了物体掉落。

TLDR: This paper presents a recipe for training in-hand object pose reaching policies for a LEAP hand in simulation, which transfer zero-shot to the real hand and achieve high success rates while a learned residual safety filter reduces object drops.

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation with multi-fingered hands is the next frontier of robotics, yet learned hand skills remain limited to simple grasps or basic repeated motions, such as rotating an object. As robots attempt more demanding in-hand maneuvers, safety, such as not dropping the object, becomes critical, yet it is rarely measured. We study in-hand object pose reaching, a task that demands diverse and difficult grasps: moving an object to almost any position and orientation within reach of the fingers, at any wrist orientation, through long sequences of consecutive goals. We present a recipe for training such policies for a LEAP hand in simulation without human data, built on a range of insights, from diverse resets and goals via generated grasp datasets to an adaptive friction curriculum. With careful system identification, the policies transfer zero-shot to the real hand, using either motion capture or a single wrist-mounted depth camera, and prove remarkably capable and robust. On top of the task policy, we add a learned residual safety filter with adjustable conservativeness, letting us tune the balance between performance and safety and greatly reduce object drops. In 13.3 hours of real-robot evaluation over 4,800 unseen goals across 4 objects and diverse wrist orientations, the state-based policy reaches 95.2% of goals within 2 cm and 0.4 rad, and the filter cuts its drops by 75% while still reaching 91.5% of goals. The policies can also spin a lightbulb held in an arbitrary pose, reach out-of-distribution goals, withstand fast arm motion and perturbations, and, needing only a wrist camera, serve as portable skills such as screwing in a lightbulb. We release the full recipe as a platform for studying performance, reliability, and safety in high-dimensional dexterous systems. Videos and more are available at https://ian-chuang.github.io/dexsafe/.

摘要（中文）：多指手的灵巧操作是机器人学的下一个前沿领域，然而目前学习到的手部技能仍局限于简单抓取或基本重复动作，例如旋转物体。随着机器人尝试更具挑战性的手持操作，安全性（如不掉落物体）变得至关重要，但这一指标却很少被量化。我们研究手内物体姿态到达任务，该任务要求多样且困难的抓取方式：在手指可达范围内，将物体移动到几乎任意位置和姿态，并在任意手腕朝向及长序列连续目标下完成。我们提出了一套训练此类策略的完整方案，用于在仿真中训练LEAP手部策略，且无需人工数据，基于多项洞见构建，包括通过生成抓取数据集实现多样化重置与目标，以及自适应摩擦课程。通过精细的系统辨识，这些策略可零样本迁移至真实手部，使用动作捕捉或单一腕部深度相机均可，并展现出卓越的能力与鲁棒性。在任务策略之上，我们增加了具有可调节保守度的学习式残差安全过滤器，使性能与安全性之间的平衡可调，并大幅减少物体掉落。在13.3小时真实机器人评估中，覆盖4个物体、多种腕部朝向及4800个未见目标，基于状态的策略在2厘米和0.4弧度误差内达到95.2%的目标达成率，而过滤器将掉落率降低75%，同时仍保持91.5%的目标达成率。该策略还能旋转任意姿态下持握的灯泡、到达分布外目标、抵抗快速手臂运动和扰动，并且仅需腕部相机即可作为便携技能使用，例如拧入灯泡。我们发布完整方案，作为研究高维灵巧系统中性能、可靠性与安全性的平台。视频及更多资源见 https://ian-chuang.github.io/dexsafe/。

Authors: Ian Chuang, Hiya Shah, Vamsi Chilamkur, Iman Soltani, Claire Tomlin

PDRVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Physical Dynamics Representations VLA

Vision-Language-Action model Physical Dynamics Module Future prediction Embodied chain-of-thought Robot manipulation

简要说明：PDRVLA通过轻量级物理动力学模块预测未来RGB、深度和光流特征来生成动作，避免了在线视频生成，在多个仿真基准上提升了成功率。

TLDR: PDRVLA enhances VLA models by integrating a lightweight Physical Dynamics Module that predicts future RGB, depth, and optical-flow features to condition action generation without online video generation, improving success rates across multiple simulation benchmarks.

Abstract: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions, but their understanding of physical dynamics remains limited. Video world models can capture scene dynamics, yet generating future videos introduces high latency into the control loop. We introduce PDRVLA, whose lightweight Physical Dynamics Module extracts physical tokens from vision--language features to condition action generation without online video generation. The module learns through direct prediction of future RGB, depth, and optical-flow features, with auxiliary supervision through a frozen pretrained video world model. Training relies entirely on publicly available data, expanded through human-to-robot synthesis, subtask annotation, and embodied chain-of-thought (ECoT) annotation. Across four simulation benchmarks, PDRVLA achieves success rates of 99.3% on LIBERO, 89.9% on LIBERO-Plus, 93.6% on RoboTwin~2.0, and 81.5% on SimplerEnv. Ablations show improved future prediction with world-model supervision and evaluate how subtask conditioning, future object-pose supervision, and ECoT training affect action success.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型根据视觉观察和语言指令生成机器人动作，但其对物理动力学的理解仍然有限。视频世界模型能够捕捉场景动态，然而生成未来视频会在控制回路中引入较高的延迟。我们提出了PDRVLA，其轻量级物理动力学模块从视觉-语言特征中提取物理令牌，以在不进行在线视频生成的情况下调节动作生成。该模块通过直接预测未来RGB、深度和光流特征进行学习，并通过冻结的预训练视频世界模型提供辅助监督。训练完全依赖公开可用的数据，并通过人-机器人合成、子任务标注和具身思维链（ECoT）标注进行扩展。在四个仿真基准测试中，PDRVLA在LIBERO上达到99.3%的成功率，在LIBERO-Plus上达到89.9%，在RoboTwin~2.0上达到93.6%，在SimplerEnv上达到81.5%。消融实验表明，世界模型监督改善了未来预测效果，并评估了子任务条件化、未来物体位姿监督以及ECoT训练对动作成功的影响。

Authors: Hanqing Wang, Zhaotian Cai, Ruichuan An, Bohan Zeng, Tao Zhang, Yilin Chen, Xu Jiang, Kaiquan Chen, Chongyang Wu, Haoran Li, Fan Yang, Mingan Lin, Wentao Zhang, Zenan Zhou, Youzheng Wu

ExecDiffuser: Closing the Sample-to-Execution Gap in Diffusion Planning AutonomousDriving

diffusion planning closed-loop driving trajectory selection replanning nuPlan

简要说明：ExecDiffuser 指出了扩散规划器中样本生成与执行之间的差距，并提出了一个循环的从提议到执行的框架，通过意图引导的提议生成和执行接地轨迹选择，在 nuPlan、InterPlan 和 NAVSIM 上取得了领先的闭环性能。

TLDR: ExecDiffuser identifies the sample-to-execution gap in diffusion-based driving planners and introduces a recurrent proposal-to-execution framework with intent-guided proposal generation and execution-grounded trajectory selection, achieving leading closed-loop performance on nuPlan, InterPlan, and NAVSIM.

Abstract: Generative planners are often evaluated by the trajectories they can generate, although closed-loop driving ultimately depends on the single candidate committed to control. We identify this mismatch as the sample-to-execution gap and show that improving proposal quality alone can worsen the executed decision. Here, we introduce ExecDiffuser, a recurrent proposal-to-execution framework that couples candidate generation, trajectory selection, and subsequent replanning through shared execution semantics. Intent-Guided Diffusion Proposal (IGD) assigns hypothesis responsibility and shapes trajectories with execution-conditioned supervision. Execution-Grounded Selection (EGS) learns a candidate-conditioned publication utility, commits one trajectory to control, and returns it as context for the next planning cycle. Across nuPlan, InterPlan, and NAVSIM, ExecDiffuser achieves leading closed-loop performance against strong state-of-the-art baselines. Under a unified five-seed protocol, it obtains an average score of 85.62, improving over Diffusion Planner and FlowDrive by 4.02 and 1.31 points, respectively. On NAVSIM, it achieves 92.6 PDMS under the official evaluation pipeline. Matched counterfactual analysis further shows that ExecDiffuser more reliably converts strong candidates into committed decisions, while prefix interventions confirm that this advantage persists after physical execution and subsequent replanning.

摘要（中文）：生成式规划器通常依据其生成的轨迹来评估，尽管闭环驾驶最终取决于控制所承诺的单一候选方案。我们指出这一不匹配为“采样到执行差距”，并表明仅提升提议质量可能反而使实际执行的决策恶化。为此，我们提出ExecDiffuser，一种循环的提议到执行框架，通过共享执行语义将候选生成、轨迹选择及后续重规划耦合在一起。意图引导扩散提议（IGD）分配假设责任，并通过执行条件监督塑造轨迹。执行接地选择（EGS）学习基于候选的发布效用，将一条轨迹承诺给控制，并将其作为上下文返回至下一规划周期。在nuPlan、InterPlan和NAVSIM上，ExecDiffuser相较于强大的最先进基线取得了领先的闭环性能。在统一的五种随机种子协议下，其平均得分为85.62，相较Diffusion Planner和FlowDrive分别提升了4.02分和1.31分。在NAVSIM上，经官方评估流程验证，其达成92.6的PDMS分数。匹配的反事实分析进一步表明，ExecDiffuser能更可靠地将优秀候选转换为实际承诺决策，而前缀干预实验则确认，在物理执行及后续重规划后，这一优势依然持续存在。

Authors: Shuo Pei, Bosun Liang, Saihui Zha, Chen Sun, Huachun Tan, Yong Wang

RoboAuto: Autonomous Robot Program Search through Multi-Level Physical Understanding Manipulation

robot program search Code-as-Policy physical understanding hierarchical knowledge base scene grounding

简要说明：RoboAuto是一个自主机器人程序搜索框架，通过分层知识库、场景接地和多阶段规划与自设计实验，在对象、场景和交互层面显式组织物理理解，增强基于LLM的Code-as-Policy代理。它在仿真基准和真实机器人长时程任务中取得优越性能，并展示了知识库跨模拟器和实体迁移的能力。

TLDR: RoboAuto is a framework for autonomous robot program search that enhances LLM-based Code-as-Policy agents by explicitly organizing physical understanding at object, scene, and interaction levels via a hierarchical knowledge base, scene grounding, and multi-stage planning with self-designed experiments. It achieves superior performance across simulation benchmarks and real-robot long-horizon tasks, demonstrating that its knowledge base transfers across simulators and embodiments.

Abstract: Recently, LLM-based autonomous agents have shown strong capabilities in iteratively generating, evaluating, and refining executable solutions. In robotic manipulation, Code-as-Policy lets these agents search over modular and editable robot programs. However, effective program search requires physical understanding: agents must understand how objects can be manipulated, how scene geometry constrains actions, and why interactions succeed or fail. Existing methods rely mainly on execution feedback for program refinement, often leaving these physical questions unresolved. We introduce RoboAuto, a framework for robot program search that explicitly organizes physical understanding at the object, scene, and interaction levels through three components. First, a hierarchical knowledge base combines executable skills with object-centric knowledge of affordances, spatial relations, and action effects, learned from embodied data and online task solving. Second, scene grounding connects this knowledge to the current environment by identifying relevant objects and resolving action-critical quantities. Third, multi-stage planning with self-designed experiments checks whether each stage produces its expected physical effects and actively tests competing hypotheses to resolve physical uncertainties. RoboAuto achieves superior performance across five benchmark families, attaining an 89.1% success rate on short-horizon LIBERO-PRO tasks and more than twice the mean success rate of ASPIRE on LIBERO-PRO Long and LIBERO-Plus. It also outperforms ASPIRE and $π_{0.5}$ on three challenging long-horizon real-robot tasks requiring precise manipulation. We further show that the knowledge base transfers across simulators and embodiments, and that program search performance scales with its size. Project page: https://roboauto-ai.github.io/

摘要（中文）：近期，基于大型语言模型的自主智能体在迭代生成、评估和优化可执行解决方案方面展现出了强大的能力。在机器人操作领域，Code-as-Policy方法使这些智能体能够在模块化、可编辑的机器人程序中进行搜索。然而，有效的程序搜索需要物理层面的理解：智能体必须理解物体如何被操作、场景几何如何约束动作，以及交互为何成功或失败。现有方法主要依赖执行反馈进行程序修正，往往使这些物理问题悬而未决。我们提出RoboAuto，一个面向机器人程序搜索的框架，通过三个组件在物体、场景和交互层面显式组织物理理解。首先，分层知识库将可执行技能与以物体为中心的可供性、空间关系和动作效果知识相结合，这些知识从具身数据和在线任务求解中习得。其次，场景接地通过识别相关物体并解析关键动作量，将知识库与当前环境相连接。第三，具备自主设计实验的多阶段规划机制，用于检验每个阶段是否产生预期的物理效果，并主动测试竞争性假设以消除物理不确定性。RoboAuto在五个基准测试系列中均取得了优越性能，在短时域LIBERO-PRO任务上达到89.1%的成功率，在LIBERO-PRO Long和LIBERO-Plus上的平均成功率是ASPIRE的两倍以上。此外，在三个需要精确操作的长时域真实机器人挑战性任务中，RoboAuto也优于ASPIRE和$π_{0.5}$。我们进一步证明了知识库可跨模拟器和具身形态迁移，且程序搜索性能随其规模扩大而提升。项目页面：https://roboauto-ai.github.io/

Authors: Buzhao Liu, Jianing Ye, Xiu Yuan, Yangtong Feng, Chengsong Huang, Tyler Dinh, Yevgeniy Vorobeychik, Ning Zhang, Chongjie Zhang

Rollback: Experience Backtracking in World Models for Policy Improvement Manipulation

world models counterfactual exploration policy improvement robot learning action-conditioned

简要说明：Rollback提出了一种策略改进范式，利用动作条件世界模型作为反事实引擎，通过回滚到关键决策点探索替代动作，提炼动作级监督，并将分布式世界模型搜索与真实机器人执行统一，在真实操作任务上显著提高了成功率。

TLDR: Rollback introduces a policy improvement paradigm that leverages action-conditioned world models as counterfactual engines by rolling back to critical decision points to explore alternative actions, distilling action-level supervision, and unifying distributed world-model search with real-robot execution, significantly improving success rates on real manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Action-conditioned world models offer a scalable alternative to costly real-world interaction for improving robot policies. However, existing world-model-based methods largely treat world models as forward-only surrogates of the physical environment, leaving untapped a capability no physical environment affords: rewinding to past decision points to explore counterfactual futures. We introduce Rollback, a policy improvement paradigm that turns world models from passive simulators into counterfactual engines: it rolls back to critical decision points, branches into alternative actions, and contrasts their outcomes to attribute success to individual decisions. This concentrates imagination where it matters most and distills counterfactual outcomes into fine-grained, action-level supervision without a separately learned value model. We build a scalable training system that unifies distributed world-model search with asynchronous real-robot execution, forming a self-reinforcing cycle: real-world experience continually sharpens the world model, and a sharper world model in turn drives further policy improvement. We term the world-model side of this cycle test-time physics grounding, a capability that hand-built physics simulators lack: while the world model serves as the training environment, real transitions from the policy it trains correct its dynamics through a lightweight LoRA pipeline. Experiments on three challenging real-world tasks show that Rollback improves success rates over the strongest baseline by an absolute 10.67%, 11.11%, and 11.85% on block extraction, ball tossing, and tabletop curling, respectively, while achieving more stable improvement throughout training. Although initialized from teleoperated demonstrations far below human level, Rollback surpasses the average success rate of human players on both ball tossing and tabletop curling within 8 hours of training.

摘要（中文）：基于动作的条件世界模型为改进机器人策略提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，能够减少对高成本真实世界交互的依赖。然而，现有的基于世界模型的方法大多将世界模型仅视为物理环境的前向代理，未能利用物理环境所不具备的一项能力：回退至过去的决策点，以探索反事实的未来。我们提出Rollback，一种策略改进范式，将世界模型从被动模拟器转变为反事实引擎：它回退至关键决策点，分支到替代动作，并对比其结果，从而将成功归因于各个具体决策。这使得想象聚焦于最关键的环节，并将反事实结果提炼为细粒度的动作级监督信号，且无需单独学习价值模型。我们构建了一个可扩展的训练系统，将分布式世界模型搜索与异步真实机器人执行相统一，形成自我强化的循环：真实世界经验持续优化世界模型，而更精准的世界模型又进一步推动策略改进。我们将该循环中世界模型侧的能力称为测试时物理基础校准，这是手工构建的物理模拟器所不具备的能力：在世界模型作为训练环境的同时，其所训练策略产生的真实转移通过轻量级LoRA流程修正模型动态。在三个具有挑战性的真实世界任务上的实验表明，Rollback在积木抽取、抛球和桌面冰壶任务中，相较于最强基线分别将成功率绝对提升了10.67%、11.11%和11.85%，并在整个训练过程中实现了更稳定的改进。尽管初始化的遥操作演示远低于人类水平，Rollback在8小时训练内，在抛球和桌面冰壶两项任务上均超越了人类玩家的平均成功率。

Authors: Jiayi Luo, Yang Zhang, Liliang Chen, Nan Wang, Chen Gao, Boxiang Qiu, Zhuoxuan Li, Baorui Peng, Chuankang Li, Yuxiang Yan, Si Liu, Qingyun Sun, Shuicheng Yan, Maoqing Yao, Jianxin Li, Guanghui Ren

EgoThumb: A Vision-Driven Supernumerary Robotic Thumb for Autonomous Grasp and Holding Assistance Manipulation

supernumerary robotic thumb visual imitation learning egocentric vision tendon-driven actuation autonomous grasping

简要说明：EgoThumb 提出了一种完全开源的、视觉驱动的超数机械拇指，采用紧凑的腱驱动设计和基于自我中心图像的视觉模仿学习，以实现自主抓取和持握辅助。

TLDR: EgoThumb introduces a fully open-source, vision-driven supernumerary robotic thumb with a compact tendon-driven design and visual imitation learning from egocentric images to autonomously assist grasping and holding.

Abstract: Supernumerary robotic fingers augment human dexterity by enabling a single hand to perform complex "hold-and-manipulate" tasks that typically require bimanual coordination. However, existing devices are often hindered by bulky hardware that limits interaction to large objects and rely on explicit hand motion triggers that lack environmental context. To address these challenges, we present EgoThumb, a fully open-source, vision-driven supernumerary robotic thumb. EgoThumb features a compact, dual tendon-driven finger whose actuation is relocated to the forearm, reducing distal weight while enabling precise active joint control. The system utilizes a visual imitation learning policy that maps egocentric images from a palm-facing camera directly to continuous joint positions. By implicitly decoding human intent from visual cues capturing both the hand and the object of interest, EgoThumb achieves robust autonomous manipulation and strong generalization across diverse users and environments. All hardware designs and software implementations are fully open-sourced at https://ego-thumb.github.io.

摘要（中文）：多余机器人手指通过使单手能够执行通常需要双手协调的复杂“握持与操作”任务，增强了人类手的灵巧性。然而，现有设备往往受限于笨重的硬件，仅能操作大型物体，并且依赖缺乏环境上下文的显式手部动作触发。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了EgoThumb，一个完全开源的、视觉驱动的多余机器人拇指。EgoThumb采用紧凑的双腱驱动手指，其驱动机构移至前臂，既减轻了远端重量，又实现了精确的主动关节控制。该系统利用视觉模仿学习策略，将来自手掌朝向摄像头的自我中心图像直接映射到连续关节位置。通过从同时捕捉手部及目标物体的视觉线索中隐式解码人类意图，EgoThumb实现了稳健的自主操作，并在不同用户和环境间展现出强大的泛化能力。所有硬件设计和软件实现均已完全开源，见 https://ego-thumb.github.io。

Authors: Jianyu Hou, Jiawei Fu, Weikang Wan, Minghui Jiang, Jiajun Li, Hao Su

When, Where, and What to Correct: Human-Guided Adaptive Residual Correction for Robot Policies Manipulation

residual correction human-guided RL frozen policy real-robot manipulation sparse human corrections

简要说明：ARC 是一个轻量级后训练模块，利用带稀疏人工校正的强化学习来学习对冻结模仿策略进行残差校正的位置和时机，将真实机器人精密操作的成功率从33.3%提升到75.0%。

TLDR: ARC is a lightweight post-training module that uses RL with sparse human corrections to learn where and when to apply residual corrections to a frozen imitation policy, improving real-robot precision manipulation success from 33.3% to 75.0%.

Abstract: Imitation policies that reliably execute most of a manipulation trajectory can still fail in localized regions requiring last-mile precision. Updating the full policy or exploring residual actions everywhere treats this local failure as a global learning problem. We introduce Adaptive Residual Correction (ARC), a lightweight post-training module that uses reinforcement learning (RL) to learn a residual correction on top of a frozen policy while using sparse human corrections to structure autonomous exploration. Rather than treating human corrections as imitation targets, ARC uses pre-intervention states to determine 'when' residual control should become active and correction geometry to determine 'where' in residual action space autonomous refinement should explore; task reward determines 'what' residual is ultimately executed. Across three precision-manipulation tasks on a real robot, ARC improves average task success from 33.3% to 75.0%. The human corrections define task-dependent 2-3 dimensional subspaces of the seven-joint residual space that retain 96.0-97.7% of squared correction magnitude. Together, these results show that sparse human corrections can localize and constrain autonomous post-training without requiring the observed correction itself to serve as the final action target.

摘要（中文）：模仿策略虽然能够可靠地执行操作轨迹的大部分，但在需要最后一步精度的局部区域仍可能失败。更新完整策略或在所有位置探索残差动作，会将这种局部失败视为全局学习问题。我们引入了自适应残差校正（ARC），一种轻量级的训练后模块，利用强化学习（RL）在冻结策略之上学习残差校正，同时使用稀疏的人工校正来引导自主探索的结构。ARC不将人工校正视为模仿目标，而是利用干预前状态来确定残差控制应“何时”激活，并利用校正几何结构来确定自主细化在残差动作空间中应“何处”探索；任务奖励则决定最终执行的残差“是什么”。在真实机器人的三项精密操作任务中，ARC将平均任务成功率从33.3%提升至75.0%。人工校正定义了七关节残差空间中依赖任务的2至3维子空间，保留了96.0%至97.7%的平方校正幅度。综合而言，这些结果表明，稀疏的人工校正能够定位并约束训练后的自主细化过程，而无需将观测到的校正本身作为最终动作目标。

Authors: Anukriti Singh, Maxime Caniot, Pratap Tokekar, Firas Abi-Farraj

Rendering-Free Event Frame Simulation for Fast Reinforcement Learning of Autonomous Robot Navigation RLRobot

event camera simulation reinforcement learning autonomous navigation tiny drone zero-shot transfer

简要说明：该论文提出了一种免渲染的解析事件相机模拟器，直接从场景几何和自身运动合成事件流，从而加速自主无人机导航的强化学习。策略能迁移到真实世界的小型无人机上并取得高成功率。

TLDR: The paper introduces a rendering-free analytic event camera simulator that synthesizes event streams directly from scene geometry and ego-motion, enabling fast reinforcement learning for autonomous drone navigation. The policy transfers to real-world flights on a tiny drone with high success rates.

Abstract: Event cameras offer low latency, high dynamic range, and milliwatt-level power consumption, making them ideal for agile robots such as tiny drones navigating through cluttered environments. However, existing simulators generally render photorealistic images before converting them into events, making large-scale reinforcement learning prohibitively slow. We propose an analytic event simulator that exploits what event cameras fundamentally measure - moving contrast edges - to synthesize event streams directly from scene geometry and ego-motion without visual rendering. Our simulator generates a 64x64 event observation in 17 microseconds on a single GPU - over 400x faster than a state-of-the-art rendering pipeline - enabling end-to-end reinforcement learning for goal-directed obstacle avoidance to converge in under 30 minutes - three orders of magnitude faster than training on rendered events. Policies transfer zero-shot to physically based event simulations (ray-traced Isaac Sim). Our policy reaches 83% success in cluttered courses unseen during training (mid-difficulty, traversability probability approx. 0.57), at 2.4 m/s average goal velocity, and retains 70% in a simulated texture-dense indoor hall. Furthermore, we quantized the policy to a 1.2 MB int8 network running fully onboard a 56-gram Crazyflie equipped with a Prophesee GenX320 event camera and an OpenMV N6 microcontroller board. Without any fine-tuning, external processing, or positioning, the policy achieves an average success rate of 82% (5/5, 5/6, 4/6 flights) across three real-world obstacle courses of increasing difficulty. Code: https://github.com/tudelft/rendering-free-event-nav

摘要（中文）：事件相机具有低延迟、高动态范围和毫瓦级功耗等优势，使其非常适合在杂乱环境中导航的微型无人机等敏捷机器人。然而，现有模拟器通常先渲染逼真图像再将其转换为事件，导致大规模强化学习速度极慢。我们提出了一种解析式事件模拟器，利用事件相机的基本测量原理——运动对比度边缘——直接从场景几何和自运动合成事件流，无需视觉渲染。我们的模拟器在单个GPU上仅需17微秒即可生成64×64的事件观测，比最先进的渲染管线快400倍以上，从而使得目标导向避障的端到端强化学习能在30分钟内收敛，比基于渲染事件的训练快三个数量级。训练得到的策略可零样本迁移至基于物理的事件模拟（光线追踪的Isaac Sim）。在训练中未出现的杂乱场景中（中等难度，可通过性概率约0.57），我们的策略实现了83%的成功率，平均目标速度达2.4米/秒，在模拟的高纹理室内大厅中保持了70%的成功率。此外，我们将策略量化为1.2MB的int8网络，完全部署在一架配备Prophesee GenX320事件相机和OpenMV N6微控制器板的56克Crazyflie无人机上。在无任何微调、外部处理或定位辅助的情况下，该策略在三个难度递增的真实世界障碍物场景中实现了82%的平均成功率（5/5、5/6、4/6次飞行）。代码地址：https://github.com/tudelft/rendering-free-event-nav

Authors: Dequan Ou, Austin Lopez, Quentin Missinne, Christophe De Wagter, Guido C. H. E. de Croon

World Dreamer v5-lite: A Multi-Robot World Action Model with One Dreamer WorldModel

multi-robot world-action model shared world state masked-view cooperative training RobotFactory VLA

简要说明：World Dreamer v5-lite 提出了一种多机器人世界动作模型，通过共享工作空间坐标的世界状态、每机器人查询和掩码视图协作训练，在仿真和真实机器人任务中取得了显著成功率。

TLDR: World Dreamer v5-lite introduces a multi-robot world-action model with a shared workspace-coordinate world state, robot-specific queries, and masked-view cooperative training, achieving strong simulated and real-robot success rates.

Abstract: Multi-robot control requires integrating distributed camera views while predicting separate action sequences. Most vision-language-action and world-action models target one robot. Combining multiple views alone does not establish spatial correspondence between them. World Dreamer v5-lite is a multi-robot world-action model built around a shared world state for robot-specific action prediction. Calibrated features from a pretrained video encoder populate this state in workspace coordinates; its spatial size remains fixed as views are added. A vision-language model provides scene context and one query per robot. The queries read the shared state and exchange pose-aware information, while their action streams remain separate. Masked-view cooperative training withholds selected camera views from both visual branches while retaining all action targets. This encourages the use of observations shared by other robots. Pretraining uses more than 10,000 hours of trajectories from 20 simulated robot types, RoboFactory, and real robots. On RoboFactory, World Dreamer v5-lite achieves 74.0% mean success, 23.7 percentage points above the strongest evaluated baseline. Across four real-robot tasks, it reaches 78.8% mean success, a margin of 13.8 points. It also reaches 58.08% overall on RoboCasa365.

摘要（中文）：多机器人控制需要在预测各自独立动作序列的同时，整合分布于不同摄像头的视角信息。大多数视觉-语言-动作模型及世界-动作模型均面向单一机器人设计。仅拼接多个视角并不能建立它们之间的空间对应关系。World Dreamer v5-lite 是一种多机器人世界-动作模型，围绕共享世界状态实现面向特定机器人的动作预测。来自预训练视频编码器的标定特征以工作空间坐标填充该状态；随着视角数量的增加，其空间尺寸保持不变。视觉-语言模型提供场景上下文，并为每个机器人生成一个查询向量。这些查询读取共享状态并交换携带位姿信息的内容，而其动作流则保持相互独立。掩蔽视角协作训练从两个视觉分支中同时剔除部分选定的相机视角，同时保留全部动作目标，从而鼓励模型利用其他机器人共享的观测信息。预训练数据包含来自20种仿真机器人类型、RoboFactory以及真实机器人的超过10,000小时轨迹。在RoboFactory上，World Dreamer v5-lite 取得了74.0%的平均成功率，较最强评估基线高出23.7个百分点。在四项真实机器人任务中，其平均成功率达到78.8%，领先13.8个百分点。此外，在RoboCasa365上，其整体成功率达到58.08%。

Authors: Guoning Wu, Zijian Cai, Yuhang Zhang, Ying Liu, Yongbin Zheng

VLA-Stem: A Lightweight Safety Mechanism for Vision-Language-Action Models via Reinforcement Learning VLA

Vision-Language-Action models safety mechanism reinforcement learning obstacle avoidance inference-time adaptation

简要说明：VLA-Stem 是一种基于强化学习的轻量级安全机制，在推理时自适应调整冻结的 VLA 策略的动作块以避开静态和动态障碍物，同时保留任务意图，在受限仿真和真实环境中提高了无碰撞任务成功率。

TLDR: VLA-Stem is a lightweight, reinforcement-learning-based safety mechanism that adaptively modifies a frozen VLA policy's action chunks at inference time to avoid static and dynamic obstacles while preserving task intent, improving collision-free task success in constrained simulation and real-world settings.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate high-level reasoning with low-level action execution for end-to-end robotic control. However, most VLA models target static manipulation in unconstrained environments, overlooking spatial constraints and dynamic obstacles. Fine-tuning VLAs on obstacle-avoidance data is a straightforward solution, but collecting such data is costly, especially for dynamic scenarios, and may degrade their original task capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose VLA-Stem, a lightweight, reinforcement-learning-based safety mechanism for VLA systems. Without fine-tuning the underlying VLA policy, VLA-Stem converts its action chunks into motion references and uses trajectory-level guidance to preserve their spatial intent while allowing flexible motion and timing adjustments. Conditioned on these references, robot proprioception, and local obstacle information, the Stem policy adaptively modifies execution at inference time, preserving the original task intent while enabling responsive adaptation to spatial constraints and dynamic obstacles. For robust and sample-efficient training, we combine teacher-student distillation with curriculum learning. We evaluate VLA-Stem on reference following, static spatial constraints, and dynamic obstacle avoidance. Across six constrained simulation settings, VLA-Stem achieves 52.8% average collision-free task success versus 23.7% for the strongest safety baseline, while preserving base-policy performance in obstacle-free settings; real-world experiments further show consistent collision reductions under static and dynamic obstacles. These results demonstrate that VLA-Stem couples high-level VLA task intent with rapid, reflex-like responses to immediate physical risks, providing a brainstem-inspired mechanism for robust robot execution.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型将高层推理与低层动作执行相结合，用于端到端机器人控制。然而，大多数VLA模型面向无约束环境中的静态操作，忽视了空间约束和动态障碍物。在避障数据上微调VLA是一种直接的解决方案，但收集此类数据成本高昂，尤其对于动态场景，且可能削弱其原有任务能力。为应对这些局限，我们提出VLA-Stem，一种基于强化学习的轻量级VLA系统安全机制。在不微调底层VLA策略的前提下，VLA-Stem将其动作片段转换为运动参考，并利用轨迹级引导保留其空间意图，同时允许灵活的运动与时序调整。以这些参考、机器人本体感知及局部障碍物信息为条件，Stem策略在推理时自适应地调整执行过程，既保留原始任务意图，又能对空间约束和动态障碍物做出响应性适应。为实现鲁棒且样本高效的训练，我们将师生蒸馏与课程学习相结合。我们在参考跟随、静态空间约束和动态避障三种场景下评估VLA-Stem。在六种受限仿真设置中，VLA-Stem的平均无碰撞任务成功率达52.8%，而最强安全基线仅为23.7%，同时在无遮挡环境中保持了基础策略的性能；真实世界实验进一步表明，在静态和动态障碍物下均能持续降低碰撞率。这些结果表明，VLA-Stem将VLA高层任务意图与对即时物理风险的快速反射式响应相结合，为机器人鲁棒执行提供了一种受脑干启发的机制。

Authors: Bojun Zou, Wenhao Yu, Jiaohao Li, Jiaxuan Lin, Guanting Ye, Haohan Geng, Weihao Yu, Yanyong Zhang, Jianmin Ji

Tokens of Motion: Primitive Motion Learning for Human-Humanoid Skill Transfer VLA

failure-aware learning diffusion policy vision-language-action model robotic manipulation negative guidance

简要说明：AFIL 利用失败轨迹作为自适应负向引导，改进扩散/流式 VLA 策略的训练与采样，提升机器人操作的鲁棒性和成功率。

TLDR: AFIL improves VLA policies by using failure trajectories as adaptive negative guidance during diffusion/flow-based training and sampling, enhancing robustness and success rates in robotic manipulation.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide a promising paradigm for scalable robotic manipulation, yet their reliance on success-only behavioral cloning leaves them brittle; lacking corrective training signals, minor execution errors rapidly compound into unrecoverable, out-of-distribution failures. To address this limitation, we propose Adaptive Failure-Informed Learning (AFIL), an end-to-end framework that leverages failure trajectories as adaptive negative guidance for diffusion- and flow-based VLA policies. AFIL uses a pretrained VLA to generate failure rollouts online, avoiding the need for handcrafted failure-mode design or human-in-the-loop recovery. It then jointly trains Dual Action Generators (DAGs) for successful and failed behaviors while sharing a common vision-language backbone, enabling efficient failure-aware policy learning with limited parameter overhead. During sampling, the failure generator adaptively steers action generation away from failure-prone regions and toward more reliable success modes, with guidance strength determined by the per-diffusion-step distance between success and failure distributions. Experiments across in-domain and out-of-domain robotic manipulation tasks, covering both short- and long-horizon settings, show that AFIL consistently improves task success rates and robustness over existing VLA baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness, efficiency, and generality.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为可扩展的机器人操作提供了一种有前景的范式，然而其仅依赖成功行为克隆的机制使其显得脆弱；由于缺乏纠正性训练信号，微小的执行误差会迅速累积为不可恢复的分布外失败。为解决这一局限，我们提出了自适应失败信息学习（AFIL），这是一种端到端框架，利用失败轨迹作为基于扩散和流的VLA策略的自适应负向引导。AFIL使用预训练的VLA在线生成失败回放，避免了对手工设计失败模式或人工介入恢复的需求。随后，它联合训练成功与失败行为的双动作生成器（DAGs），同时共享共同的视觉-语言骨干网络，从而在有限参数开销下实现高效的失败感知策略学习。在采样过程中，失败生成器自适应地将动作生成从易失败区域引导至更可靠的成功模式，引导强度由每个扩散步骤中成功与失败分布之间的距离决定。跨领域内和领域外机器人操作任务的实验，涵盖短程和长程两种设置，表明AFIL相比现有VLA基线持续提升了任务成功率和鲁棒性，验证了其有效性、高效性和泛化能力。

Authors: Hanwen Ren, Meng Zheng, Wenzhe Cui, Benjamin Planche, Zhongpai Gao, Anwesa Choudhuri, Terrence Chen, Ziyan Wu

Vision-Language-Action or World-Action? Just Action Models VLA

vision-language-action world-action model foresight loss robot policy LIBERO

简要说明：本文提出Just Action Model (JAM)框架，将骨干网络初始化、未来观测目标和推理机制解耦，统一VLA和WAM方法，证明未来监督可在无视觉生成的情况下提升机器人控制性能，在LIBERO基准上超越FastWAM并降低训练计算量。

TLDR: The paper proposes Just Action Model (JAM), a framework that decouples backbone initialization, future-observation objective, and inference machinery to unify VLA and WAM approaches, showing that future supervision improves robot control without visual generation, outperforming FastWAM on LIBERO benchmarks with reduced training FLOPs.

Abstract: The vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action model (WAM) communities debate whether control policies should inherit pretrained knowledge from vision-language models or from visual generators. The debate, however, bundles three separable choices: backbone initialization, the objective applied to future observations, and whether the machinery for that future loss is kept at inference. A gap between a VLA and a WAM therefore cannot simply be attributed to any one of them. We show that decoupling these choices yields a common framework for both families, which we term Just Action Model (JAM): a pretrained visual backbone with an action expert, trained with an action loss and a foresight loss. The foresight loss trains current-observation features to predict frozen encodings of the recorded future through a prediction head discarded after training, so no visual generation is involved in either training or inference, and the backbone can be chosen freely. We first compare objectives within fixed policy architectures, then evaluate the foresight recipe across backbone families. The resulting JAM policies outperform their matched FastWAM and ImageWAM counterparts on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, and achieve similar or slightly higher success rates on RoboTwin. Compared with FastWAM, JAM improves the success rates from 97.0%/55.3%/91.2% to 98.2%/64.5%/91.4%, respectively. With cached foresight targets, JAM reduces estimated online training FLOPs per sample per update by 73% relative to FastWAM. Our results show that future supervision improves control without visual generation or additional inference machinery, and strong foresight performance is attainable with either generator-initialized or vision-language backbones. Project Page: https://y0uroy.github.io/JAM

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型与世界-动作模型（WAM）两个研究阵营围绕控制策略应当继承来自视觉-语言模型还是视觉生成器的预训练知识展开了争论。然而，这一争论实际上混淆了三个可分离的选择：骨干网络初始化方式、未来观测所施加的损失目标，以及该未来损失所需机制在推理阶段是否保留。因此，VLA与WAM之间的性能差距不能简单地归因于其中任何一个因素。我们证明，将这三个选择解耦后可以得到一个统一框架，涵盖上述两个模型家族，我们将其称为“纯动作模型”（Just Action Model, JAM）：即一个预训练的视觉骨干网络搭配一个动作专家模块，以动作损失和前瞻损失联合训练。前瞻损失通过一个在训练后被丢弃的预测头，训练当前观测特征去预测已录制未来的冻结编码，因此在训练和推理过程中均不涉及视觉生成，且骨干网络可以自由选择。我们首先在固定策略架构内比较不同损失目标， затем在多种骨干网络家族上评估前瞻训练方案。由此得到的JAM策略在LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus基准上均优于对应的FastWAM和ImageWAM模型，在RoboTwin上则达到相近或略高的成功率。与FastWAM相比，JAM将成功率分别从97.0%/55.3%/91.2%提升至98.2%/64.5%/91.4%。借助缓存的前瞻目标，JAM在每次更新的每个样本上的估计在线训练FLOPs较FastWAM减少了73%。我们的结果表明，未来监督能够在无需视觉生成或额外推理机制的条件下提升控制性能，并且无论是使用生成器初始化的骨干网络还是视觉-语言骨干网络，均可实现强劲的前瞻性能。项目页面：https://y0uroy.github.io/JAM

Authors: Yonghao Yu, Lang Huang, Runyi Li, Toshihiko Yamasaki

Retrieve to Act: Motion Primitive Graph Retrieval for Robust VLA Execution VLA

Vision-Language-Action test-time scaling motion primitive graph out-of-distribution robustness graph neural network

简要说明：R2A 是一种测试时扩展框架，通过从离线图中检索几何上兼容的运动基元，并使用学习到的门控机制与冻结的 VLA 策略输出融合，从而提升 VLA 策略对分布外视觉变化的鲁棒性，在仿真和真实机器人基准上均显示出一致提升。

TLDR: R2A is a test-time scaling framework that improves VLA robustness to out-of-distribution visual shifts by retrieving geometrically compatible motion primitives from an offline graph and blending them with frozen policy outputs via learned gating, showing consistent gains across simulation and real robot benchmarks.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies demonstrate remarkable semantic generalization, yet remain highly vulnerable to out-of-distribution (OOD) visual shifts during execution. While existing test-time methods attempt to suppress spurious visual cues, they fundamentally overlook the rich, uncorrupted kinematic priors embedded in the policy's own training experience. We introduce Retrieve to Act (R2A), a test-time scaling framework that formulates OOD robustness purely as a geometric motion primitive retrieval problem. R2A bypasses fragile visual features by structuring successful training demonstrations into an offline spatiotemporal motion primitive graph. During inference, a query-dependent Graph Neural Network dynamically localizes the robot's ongoing execution within this graph, retrieving structurally compatible future motion primitives. These retrieved geometric priors are then seamlessly harmonized with the frozen VLA's predicted actions via a learned, dimension-wise gating mechanism, adaptively rectifying erroneous spatial trajectories while preserving the policy's local reactivity. Extensive experiments across three state-of-the-art VLA architectures, GR00T N1.7, $π_{0.5}$, and StableVLA, demonstrate that R2A consistently and significantly enhances robustness against diverse contextual perturbations. R2A achieves absolute success rate improvements of up to +12% in simulation benchmarks (LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin2.0-Plus) and +40% in real-world deployments, without requiring any finetuning of the base policies. Project page: https://retrieve2act.github.io/r2a/

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略展现出卓越的语义泛化能力，但在执行过程中对分布外（OOD）视觉变化仍高度敏感。现有测试时方法虽然试图抑制虚假视觉线索，但本质上忽视了策略自身训练经验中蕴含的丰富且未受损的运动学先验。我们提出“检索以行动”（R2A），一种测试时扩展框架，将OOD鲁棒性纯粹建模为几何运动基元检索问题。R2A通过将成功的训练演示构建为离线时空运动基元图，绕过了脆弱的视觉特征。在推理阶段，查询相关的图神经网络动态定位机器人当前执行在图中的位置，检索结构兼容的未来运动基元。这些检索到的几何先验随后通过习得的逐维度门控机制与冻结的VLA预测动作无缝融合，在保持策略局部响应性的同时自适应纠正错误的空间轨迹。在三种最先进的VLA架构——GR00T N1.7、$π_{0.5}$和StableVLA——上的广泛实验表明，R2A在各种上下文扰动下持续且显著地增强了鲁棒性。R2A在仿真基准（LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin2.0-Plus）中实现了高达+12%的绝对成功率提升，在真实世界部署中提升达+40%，且无需对基础策略进行任何微调。项目页面：https://retrieve2act.github.io/r2a/

Authors: Pham Tri Quang, Bao-Ngoc Dao, Minh Duc Nguyen, Duc-Duy Nguyen, Hung T. Ho, Linh Dang Le, Trong-Bao Ho, Thien-Loc Ha, Tan Q. Nguyen, Tuan Dam, Vu N. Duong, Daniel Sonntag, Ngan Le, Khoa D. Doan, Jan Peters, An Thai Le, Duy M. H. Nguyen, Vien Anh Ngo

From 12 to 200 Demonstrations: How ACT, Diffusion Policy, SmolVLA and $π_{0.5}$ Scale on a Low-Cost Arm VLA

imitation learning policy scaling robot manipulation data efficiency fine-tuning

简要说明：论文在低成本机械臂上系统比较了ACT、Diffusion Policy、SmolVLA和π0.5四种模仿学习策略在不同演示数量下的扩展性能，揭示了各自的扩展趋势和失效模式，其中π0.5在数据稀缺时表现最佳，而ACT在数据充足时更优。

TLDR: This paper systematically benchmarks four imitation learning policies (ACT, Diffusion Policy, SmolVLA, and π0.5) on a low-cost robotic arm across varying numbers of demonstrations, revealing scaling trends and failure modes, with π0.5 excelling in low-data regimes and ACT dominating with more data.

Abstract: We trained four widely used imitation-learning policies, ACT, Diffusion Policy, SmolVLA and $π_{0.5}$, on nested subsets of 12, 25, 50, 100 and 200 teleoperated demonstrations of one pick-and-place task with distractor objects, using one fixed training recipe per policy. Every trained model was then run on a physical SO-101 arm on a fixed set of object placements: 1,340 scored episodes in 126 blocks. ACT, trained from scratch, rose from 1 success in 40 episodes at 12 demonstrations to 37 in 40 at 100. $π_{0.5}$ with its action expert fine-tuned was the best policy when data was scarce (16 of 40 at 12 demonstrations, 28 of 40 at 25) and then stayed near 70%; from 100 demonstrations ACT was ahead, by a margin this study does not fully resolve. SmolVLA and Diffusion Policy peaked near 50%, and both were affected by a failure to start: SmolVLA's arm never started moving in 47% of episodes, and Diffusion Policy hardly ever started until an idle lead-in was trimmed from the demonstrations. For $π_{0.5}$ the fine-tuning recipe mattered more than the amount of data: low-rank adaptation succeeded in 4 of 110 episodes, against 130 of 200 for action-expert fine-tuning. From the joint and camera recordings we place every episode on a four-stage ladder (started, reached the ball, carried it, delivered it) and show that for ACT more data moves failures from reaching, to grasping, to none, while the failures $π_{0.5}$ retains are in grasping. We also measure how weak a ten-episode block is as a measurement (the same checkpoint tested twice differs by 2 successes in 10 on average), separate seed-to-seed variation from that noise, and audit the human scoring against the recordings. Training length was fixed within each recipe, so the amount of data and the number of times it was seen change together; we state which conclusions survive that confound and which do not.

摘要（中文）：我们针对一个包含干扰物的抓放任务，在12、25、50、100和200次遥操作演示的嵌套子集上，采用每种策略固定不变的训练配置，训练了四种广泛使用的模仿学习策略：ACT、Diffusion Policy、SmolVLA和$π_{0.5}$。随后，每个训练好的模型均在物理SO-101机械臂上，针对一组固定的物体摆放位置进行测试：共126组、1，340次计分回合。 从零训练的ACT，其成功率从12次演示时的40回合中成功1次，提升至100次演示时的40回合中成功37次。在数据稀缺场景下，采用动作专家微调的$π_{0.5}$表现最佳（12次演示时40回合成功16次，25次演示时40回合成功28次），之后稳定在70%左右；从100次演示开始，ACT反超领先，但本研究所显示的领先幅度尚不完全明确。SmolVLA和Diffusion Policy的成功率峰值接近50%，且两者均受到启动失败的影响：SmolVLA的机械臂在47%的回合中从未开始运动，而Diffusion Policy在从演示中去除空闲引导段之前几乎无法启动。对于$π_{0.5}$而言，微调方法比数据量更为关键：低秩适配在110回合中仅成功4次，而动作专家微调在200回合中成功130次。 基于关节和相机记录，我们将每个回合划分为四个阶段阶梯（启动、到达球体、抓取球体、投放球体），并表明对于ACT，更多数据使失败从“到达”阶段转移到“抓取”阶段，再最终消除；而$π_{0.5}$剩余的失败集中在“抓取”阶段。我们还量化了十回合组作为评估样本的薄弱性（同一检查点测试两次，平均差异为10回合中相差2次成功），将种子间变异与上述噪声区分开，并根据记录对人工评分进行了审核。每种配置的训练时长固定，因此数据量和数据被观测的次数同时变化；我们明确指出哪些结论在该混杂因素下依然成立，哪些则不再成立。

Authors: Simon Cowling

GAWM: A Compact Latent World-Action Model for Multi-Task Robot Manipulation Manipulation

latent world model robot manipulation action prediction frozen visual encoder multi-task policy

简要说明：本文提出GAWM，一种紧凑的潜在世界动作模型，用于多任务机器人操作，在冻结视觉编码器的潜在空间中预测未来观测，通过任务条件预测器和动作解码器，以不到1亿参数和低推理延迟实现强劲性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes GAWM, a compact latent world-action model for multi-task robot manipulation that predicts future observations in the latent space of a frozen visual encoder, using a task-conditioned predictor and an action decoder, achieving strong performance with under 100M parameters and low inference latency.

Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) incorporate the prediction of future observations into robot policy learning. However, most WAMs build on billion-parameter vision-language or video-generation backbones, which incur high training cost and inference latency. In this letter, we present GAWM (Geometry-Aware World Model), a compact multi-task WAM that predicts future observations in the latent space of a frozen DINOv3 encoder. GAWM compresses the features of each camera view into a small set of tokens. A lightweight predictor, conditioned on the task rather than on actions, forecasts these tokens at two future horizons. The forecast is supervised with the dense patch features of future frames, which requires it to encode the spatial layout of the future scene. An action decoder directly regresses a chunk of future actions from the current and predicted tokens. With fewer than 100M parameters and no robot or video pretraining, GAWM outperforms billion-parameter WAMs on RoboTwin 2.0 and performs comparably to billion-parameter VLAs on LIBERO. On a dual-arm robot, it achieves lower action-prediction error on held-out demonstrations than a fine-tuned billion-parameter VLA, with substantially lower inference latency. Ablation studies show that the latent world model substantially improves performance when training data or training time is limited. Code is available at https://github.com/gaoxiang12/ga-wm.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）将未来观测的预测融入机器人策略学习之中。然而，大多数WAMs基于数十亿参数的视觉-语言或视频生成骨干网络，导致训练成本高、推理延迟大。本文提出GAWM（几何感知世界模型，Geometry-Aware World Model），一种紧凑的多任务WAM，在冻结的DINOv3编码器的潜空间中预测未来观测。GAWM将每个相机视角的特征压缩为一小组令牌。一个轻量级预测器以任务而非动作为条件，在两个未来时间范围内预测这些令牌。预测结果以未来帧的密集块特征作为监督信号，要求其编码未来场景的空间布局。动作解码器直接从当前及预测令牌中回归出一段未来动作序列。在参数少于1亿且无需机器人或视频预训练的情况下，GAWM在RoboTwin 2.0上超越了数十亿参数的WAMs，并在LIBERO上与数十亿参数的VLAs表现相当。在双臂机器人上，其在留存演示上的动作预测误差低于微调后的数十亿参数VLA，且推理延迟显著更低。消融研究表明，当训练数据或训练时间有限时，潜世界模型能够显著提升性能。代码已开源至 https://github.com/gaoxiang12/ga-wm。

Authors: Yang Liu, Xiaoli Liu, Liuzhao Li, Yuduo Song, Muyuan Liu, Xiang Gao

Keeping Contact: Task-Adaptive Friction Margins for Bimanual Non-Prehensile Manipulation Manipulation

non-prehensile manipulation friction margin bimanual manipulation contact force optimization SOCP

简要说明：本文针对双臂非抓取操作，提出基于符号摩擦距离的任务自适应摩擦裕度，并嵌入二阶锥规划中以维持接触并平衡物体，通过真实实验验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces a task-adaptive friction margin based on signed friction distance for bimanual non-prehensile manipulation, embedded in SOCPs to maintain contact and balance objects against environmental pivots, validated in real-world experiments.

Abstract: Maintaining contact in non-prehensile manipulation requires more than nominal friction cone feasibility: a force barely inside the cone and one well inside it are both feasible, but they provide different margins against slip and contact loss. This paper uses signed friction distance to measure friction margin in force space and derives a task-adaptive margin from the force correction needed to balance pivot moment deviations in bimanual tilting. The resulting contact margins are embedded in a sequence of second-order cone programs (SOCPs), each giving a globally optimal contact force solution at a tilt angle. The optimizer balances the object about an environmental pivot while keeping robot and pivot contact forces away from the nominal friction boundary. Optimizer-level results show interpretable force redistribution and adaptation to object property changes. Real-world experiments demonstrate successful execution under object property variations and model mismatch, while fixed margin and no-margin comparisons illustrate the importance of adapting the margin to task demand. These results support signed friction distance margins as a force planning mechanism for maintaining contact in bimanual non-prehensile manipulation. Project page: https://keeping-contact.github.io/

摘要（中文）：维持非抓取操作中的接触，其要求并不仅限于名义上的摩擦锥可行性：一个恰好位于锥内的力和一个深度位于锥内的力虽均可行，但二者在抵御滑动和接触丧失方面所提供的裕度却有所不同。本文采用有符号摩擦距离来度量力空间中的摩擦裕度，并基于平衡双臂倾斜操作中枢轴力矩偏差所需的力修正量，推导出一种任务自适应的裕度。由此得到的接触裕度被嵌入一系列二阶锥规划（SOCP）中，每个规划在给定倾斜角度下提供全局最优的接触力解。该优化器在使机器人及环境枢轴接触力远离名义摩擦边界的同时，实现物体绕环境枢轴的平衡。优化器层面结果展示了可解释的力再分配及对物体属性变化的适应性。真实世界实验验证了在物体属性变化和模型失配条件下的成功执行，而与固定裕度及无裕度方案的对比则凸显了根据任务需求调整裕度的重要性。上述结果支持将有符号摩擦距离裕度作为双臂非抓取操作中维持接触的一种力规划机制。项目页面：https://keeping-contact.github.io/

Authors: Qian Ying Lee, Lin Yang, Domenico Campolo

ActiveAlign: Aligning Egocentric Manipulation via Active Perception Manipulation

active perception real2sim2real hand-eye calibration tactile feedback differentiable rendering

简要说明：ActiveAlign通过主动感知（挥手和触摸）来对齐真实到仿真到真实的差距，在真实的Unitree G1机器人上实现了毫米级精度的精细操作。

TLDR: ActiveAlign uses active perception (waving and touching) to align Real2Sim2Real gaps for robot manipulation, achieving millimeter-level precision on a real Unitree G1 robot.

Abstract: Real-to-Sim-to-Real (Real2Sim2Real) enables structured world representations for planning, interpretability, and safe execution. Most existing approaches rely on passive perception, which creates real2sim gaps due to imperfect observation. Inspired by how humans perceive actively through actions, we propose ActiveAlign, a framework that leverages active perception to align the Real2Sim2Real gap from interactions. ActiveAlign introduces two complementary modules: (i) ActiveAlign-Waving, which performs hand-eye calibration by exploiting active hand motions and differentiable rendering, and (ii) ActiveAlign-Touching, which refines object alignment through tactile feedback to achieve millimeter-level precision. Together, these capabilities enable strong real2sim alignment. We demonstrate that ActiveAlign-Waving can be used to curate simulation environments for open-sourced uncalibrated robot manipulation datasets, and demonstrate on a real Unitree G1 robot that ActiveAlign enables fine manipulation of millimeter-scale objects such as pressing buttons and moving sliders.

摘要（中文）：真实到仿真再到真实（Real2Sim2Real）通过结构化的世界表示，为规划、可解释性和安全执行提供了支持。然而，大多数现有方法依赖被动感知，由于观测不完善，容易产生真实与仿真之间的差距。受人类通过动作进行主动感知方式的启发，我们提出了ActiveAlign框架，利用主动感知来弥合Real2Sim2Real中的差距。ActiveAlign引入了两个互补模块：(i) ActiveAlign-Waving，通过主动手部运动和可微渲染实现手眼标定；(ii) ActiveAlign-Touching，通过触觉反馈优化物体对齐，达到毫米级精度。这两种能力的结合实现了强大的真实与仿真对齐效果。我们验证了ActiveAlign-Waving可用于为开源未标定机器人操作数据集构建仿真环境，并在真实的宇树G1机器人上展示了ActiveAlign能够实现毫米级物体的精细操作，如按压按钮和拨动滑块。

Authors: Ri-Zhao Qiu, Bowen Wen, Yifeng Jiang, Chen Tessler, Eric Heiden, Xue Bin Peng, Xiaolong Wang, Stan Birchfield, Erwin Coumans

Trace-WAM: Learning to Act via 3D Motion Prediction for World Action Models WorldModel

World Action Models 3D motion prediction Mixture-of-Transformer robot manipulation generalization

简要说明：Trace-WAM 通过添加 3D 运动预测作为辅助目标来增强世界动作模型，利用三分支混合 Transformer 架构提高机器人操作性能和泛化能力。

TLDR: Trace-WAM enhances World Action Models by adding 3D motion prediction as an auxiliary objective, improving robot manipulation performance and generalization with a three-branch Mixture-of-Transformer architecture.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) learn representations for robot control by coupling future visual prediction with action generation. Successful manipulation depends primarily on how the robot and task-relevant objects evolve, whereas future-video prediction must also reconstruct the appearance and background of the entire scene. We therefore propose Trace-WAM, which augments video-action learning with future 3D motion prediction as an auxiliary objective. This objective supervises temporal point correspondence together with image-plane displacement and depth change, directly describing the interaction dynamics and spatial changes involved in manipulation. To this end, we adopt a three-branch Mixture-of-Transformer (Tri-MoT) architecture to jointly learn video prediction, motion prediction, and action generation. The motion expert predicts future trajectories from current visual features, allowing motion supervision to shape the representations used for action generation. Because the action expert does not consume predicted trajectories, inference retains the current-observation policy path: a single visual forward pass followed by action denoising. Experiments on RoboCasa-GR1, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus demonstrate strong in-distribution performance and out-of-distribution generalization, with particularly clear gains over Fast-WAM under limited demonstrations and distribution shifts.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）通过将未来视觉预测与动作生成相结合，学习用于机器人控制的表现形式。成功操作主要取决于机器人与任务相关物体如何演变，而未来视频预测还必须重建整个场景的外观与背景。为此，我们提出Trace-WAM，将未来三维运动预测作为辅助目标，增强视频-动作学习。该目标同时监督时间点对应关系以及图像平面位移和深度变化，直接描述操作中涉及的交互动态与空间变化。为实现此目标，我们采用三分支Transformer混合架构（Tri-MoT），联合学习视频预测、运动预测和动作生成。运动专家根据当前视觉特征预测未来轨迹，使运动监督能够塑造用于动作生成的表现形式。由于动作专家不消耗预测轨迹，推理过程保持当前观测的策略路径：一次视觉前向传播，随后进行动作去噪。在RoboCasa-GR1、LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus上的实验表明，该方法具有出色的分布内性能和分布外泛化能力，尤其在有限演示样本和分布偏移情况下，相较于Fast-WAM表现出显著优势。

Authors: Xu Hu, Changjie Wu, Linzhe Shi, Hang Zhang, Chen Yang, Lingjun Zhang, Guowen Zhang, Mu Xu, Junran Peng, Qing Li, Zhaoxiang Zhang

HC2Robot: Hyper-Connection Transformers with Predicted Foresight for Multi-Terrain Humanoid Parkour Locomotion

humanoid parkour predicted foresight asymmetric actor-critic Hyper-Connection Transformer legged locomotion

简要说明：本文介绍了HC2Robot，一种用于人形跑酷的框架，通过预测前视模块和超连接Transformer从可部署观测中预测未来落脚点的时机、位置和支撑质量，弥合教师与学生策略之间的信息不对称，并在仿真中实现了高穿越成功率和安全落脚点率。

TLDR: This paper introduces HC2Robot, a framework for humanoid parkour that uses a Predicted Foresight Module and a Hyper-Connection Transformer to predict future foothold timing, location, and support quality from deployable observations, bridging the information asymmetry between teacher and student policies and achieving high traversal success and safe foothold rates in simulation.

Abstract: Humanoid parkour requires robots to reason about future footholds and whole-body motions over highly discontinuous terrain. We revisit the information asymmetry in asymmetric actor-critic learning for perceptive humanoid locomotion: the critic exploits privileged simulator signals during training, whereas the deployable actor operates solely from onboard perception. We argue that the key is not exposing privileged information to the actor, but learning a deployable approximation of it to narrow the information gap between training and deployment. We present HC2Robot, a deployable perceptive humanoid parkour framework consisting of a Predicted Foresight Module (PFM) and a Hyper-Connection (HC) Transformer. PFM predicts from deployable observations the policy-conditioned timing, location, and support quality of each foot's next touchdown event, converting privileged supervision into a deployable latent representation that provides the actor with predicted touchdown information without privileged runtime sensing. The HC Transformer further enhances temporal reasoning through learnable multi-stream routing, while a future motion prediction head provides short-horizon motion priors for regularization. Across stairs, gaps, high platforms, and slopes, HC2Robot achieves a mean simulated traversal success rate of 97.60% and consistently higher safe foothold rates than strong perceptive locomotion baselines, supporting improved traversal performance and geometric foothold support under deployable sensing.

摘要（中文）：类人机器人跑酷要求机器人在高度不连续的地形上推理未来的落脚点及全身运动。我们重新审视了非对称演员-评论家学习框架中用于感知类人机器人运动的信息不对称问题：在训练过程中，评论家利用特权模拟器信号，而可部署的演员仅依赖机载感知信息。我们认为，关键不在于将特权信息直接暴露给演员，而在于学习其可部署的近似形式，以缩小训练与部署之间的信息差距。我们提出了HC2Robot，一个可部署的感知类人机器人跑酷框架，包含预测前瞻模块（PFM）和超连接（HC）Transformer。PFM从可部署观测中预测每个脚下一次触地事件的策略条件化时间、位置及支撑质量，将特权监督转化为可部署的潜在表征，使演员无需特权运行时感知即可获得预测的触地信息。HC Transformer通过可学习的多流路由进一步增强时序推理能力，同时未来的运动预测头提供短视界运动先验用于正则化。在楼梯、间隙、高平台和坡道上，HC2Robot实现了97.60%的平均模拟穿越成功率，并且安全落脚点率始终高于强感知运动基线，从而在可部署感知条件下提升了穿越性能和几何落脚点支撑能力。

Authors: Wenhao Xu, Yanheng Mai, Yifei Fu, Nan Zheng, Yanbo Zhou, Zirui Huang, Mingsheng Ling, Xinjue Wang, Renjing Xu

TAPESTRY: A Single Backbone for Video Generation and Robot Control VLA

world action model video diffusion transformer action tokenization robot policy efficient inference

简要说明：TAPESTRY 将预训练的视频扩散变压器改造为机器人世界动作模型，通过将动作视为视频补丁，在不生成完整视频的情况下高效生成动作。

TLDR: TAPESTRY repurposes a pretrained video diffusion transformer into a robotic world action model by tokenizing actions as video patches, enabling efficient action generation without full video synthesis at inference.

Abstract: Pretrained video generation models encode rich priors about physical interactions, but leveraging them for robot control typically requires either resource-intensive video generation at test time or action heads trained from scratch that do not fully utilize the pretrained backbone. We introduce Tokenizing Actions as Video Patches in a Shared Transformer Policy (TAPESTRY), a world action model that repurposes a pretrained video diffusion transformer into a robotic policy without requiring video generation at inference. Our key idea is to treat robot actions as single-patch tokens in the video model's latent space. A lightweight linear projection maps each action timestep to the patch dimensions of the pretrained VAE, and the resulting tokens are processed by the same patchifying layers and transformer backbone used for video. The shared backbone is optimized through three diffusion objectives sampled per minibatch element: Video diffusion uses VAE latents from robot and human videos to establish dynamics priors. Joint video+action diffusion trains on robot demonstrations using a coupled diffusion timestep and an asymmetric attention mask. Action-only diffusion denoises actions conditioned on clean image latents. At test time, the model generates a compact action token sequence in a single DDIM step from pure noise, producing smooth action chunks at 84 ms per action chunk on consumer hardware and avoiding the cost of full video generation. Across simulation benchmarks and real-robot experiments, TAPESTRY achieves strong performance with substantially lower inference cost than comparable joint video--action policies. More information can be found at https://tapestry-wam.github.io.

摘要（中文）：预训练的视频生成模型编码了关于物理交互的丰富先验知识，但将其用于机器人控制通常需要在测试时进行资源密集型的视频生成，或从头训练未能充分利用预训练主干网络的动作头。我们提出了一种名为TAPESTRY（Tokenizing Actions as Video Patches in a Shared Transformer Policy）的世界动作模型，该模型将预训练的视频扩散Transformer重新用作机器人策略，而无需在推理时进行视频生成。我们的关键思想是将机器人动作视为视频模型潜空间中的单块（single-patch）令牌。一个轻量级线性投影将每个动作时间步映射到预训练VAE的块维度，生成的令牌由用于视频的相同分块层和Transformer主干网络处理。共享主干网络通过每个小批量元素采样的三个扩散目标进行优化：视频扩散利用来自机器人和人类视频的VAE潜变量建立动力学先验；联合视频+动作扩散在机器人示范数据上训练，采用耦合扩散时间步和非对称注意力掩码；仅动作扩散在干净图像潜变量条件下对动作进行去噪。在测试时，模型通过单步DDIM从纯噪声中生成紧凑的动作令牌序列，在消费级硬件上以每个动作块84毫秒的速度产生平滑的动作块，避免了完整视频生成的代价。在仿真基准测试和真实机器人实验中，TAPESTRY实现了强性能，且推理成本远低于同等联合视频-动作策略。更多信息请访问 https://tapestry-wam.github.io。

Authors: Jeremy A. Collins, Seungjae Lee, Rachanon Wachakorn, Krishnan Srinivasan, Animesh Garg, Vitor Campagnolo Guizilini, Paarth Shah

RynnWorld-Latent: A Cross-Embodiment World Model Conditioned on Universal Latent Actions WorldModel

cross-embodiment latent actions video world model data generation policy learning

简要说明：RynnWorld-Latent 提出了一种基于通用潜在动作的跨具身视频世界模型，利用RynnLAM的3D潜在动作作为共享条件接口，在人类与机器人异构数据上联合预训练，并通过合成数据生成提升真实机器人策略成功率。

TLDR: RynnWorld-Latent introduces a cross-embodiment video world model conditioned on 3D-grounded latent actions from RynnLAM, enabling joint pretraining on human and robot data for controllable video prediction and policy data generation. Experiments show improved world model metrics and real-robot policy success via synthetic mid-training and data generation.

Abstract: Learning controllable world dynamics from heterogeneous interaction videos is challenging because robot embodiments use incompatible action spaces, while human videos lack native control labels. We present RynnWorld-Latent, a cross-embodiment video world model that uses the 3D-grounded latent actions introduced by RynnLAM as a shared conditioning interface. This representation enables joint pretraining on human interaction videos, robot demonstrations, and simulation rollouts without requiring a common native action space. Built on a pretrained video transformer, RynnWorld-Latent combines global action tokens with an identity-initialized local pathway that aligns actions with future video latents. We pretrain on 23 datasets comprising approximately 553.5M frames and adapt the model to target robots through post-training. The framework supports two data-generation routes: digital teleoperation uses target robot commands to generate action-video demonstrations, while latent-action synthesis transfers source motion to an edited initial frame and pairs the resulting rollout with retargeted pseudo robot actions. Experiments show improved video prediction metrics on public benchmarks and two real-robot platforms, alongside qualitative action following when different action sequences share the same initial observation. Synthetic mid-training improves policy success rates on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, and both generation routes improve real-world policy success rates over real-demonstration-only training in the evaluated settings. These results support universal latent actions as a scalable interface for learning controllable visual dynamics across heterogeneous embodiments.

摘要（中文）：从异构交互视频中学习可控的世界动力学颇具挑战性，原因在于机器人本体采用不兼容的动作空间，而人类视频缺乏原生控制标签。我们提出RynnWorld-Latent，一种跨本体视频世界模型，利用RynnLAM引入的基于三维接地潜在动作作为共享条件接口。该表示使得在人类交互视频、机器人演示和仿真 rollout 上的联合预训练成为可能，且无需共同的原生动作空间。RynnWorld-Latent 基于预训练的视频 transformer 构建，将全局动作令牌与身份初始化的局部路径相结合，使动作与未来视频潜在表示对齐。我们在包含约5.535亿帧的23个数据集上进行预训练，并通过后训练将模型适配到目标机器人。该框架支持两条数据生成路径：数字遥操作利用目标机器人命令生成动作-视频演示，而潜在动作合成则将源动作迁移到编辑后的初始帧，并将生成的 rollout 与重定向的伪机器人动作配对。实验表明，在公开基准和两个真实机器人平台上，视频预测指标有所提升，且在不同动作序列共享同一初始观测时，动作跟随表现呈现定性改善。合成中期训练提升了LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus上的策略成功率，且在评估设置中，两条生成路径均较仅使用真实演示的训练提升了真实世界策略成功率。这些结果支持通用潜在动作作为跨异构本体学习可控视觉动力学的可扩展接口。

Authors: Haoyu Zhao, Yinzhou Tang, Zixuan Wang, Minghao Zhu, Dongchi Huang, Xingyue Zhao, Qin Zhao, Kehan Li, Siteng Huang, Xin Li, Zhenyu Zeng, Mingxiu Chen, Deli Zhao, Zhongyu Li

TOPS: Reshaping Flow Source and Transport for Multi-Task Robot Manipulation Manipulation

flow matching multi-task manipulation task-oriented priors interpolation schedule language-conditioned policy

简要说明：TOPS针对语言条件下的机器人操作任务，按任务调整流生成源和插值调度，在不改变网络结构的情况下提升成功率与推理效率，在LIBERO、CALVIN及真实任务上效果显著。

TLDR: TOPS adapts the flow source prior and interpolation schedule per task for language-conditioned robot manipulation, improving success rates and inference efficiency on LIBERO, CALVIN, and real-world tasks without changing the network architecture.

Abstract: Flow-based policies for language-conditioned multi-task manipulation commonly share a single $\textit{Gaussian}$ source prior and a common linear transport path across tasks. However, reliably executing multiple tasks with distinct motion requirements remains challenging for a shared policy. We introduce $\textbf{TOPS}$ ($\textbf{T}$ask-$\textbf{O}$riented $\textbf{P}$riors and $\textbf{S}$chedules), which adapts the flow source prior and interpolation schedule to each task without modifying the network architecture. TOPS first constructs multimodal task sources from reverse-mapped expert action sequences, allowing language instructions to select where generation begins. Guided by source-target covariance mismatch, it then slows the transition toward expert actions early in denoising and accelerates it later along directions requiring expansion. Under a $\textit{Gaussian}$ endpoint model, our analysis shows that this schedule adjustment can lower an upper bound on velocity-prediction risk. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and CALVIN demonstrate improved performance across in-distribution, perturbation and cross-environment settings, alongside better data efficiency. Using one integration step, TOPS raises LIBERO-10 success from $53.44\%$ to $69.67\%$ compared with ten-step Standard Flow Matching (FM), while reducing inference time to approximately one-sixth of the baseline. TOPS also yields consistent gains when transferred to the large-scale flow-based $π_{0.5}$ policy across all four evaluated settings. Real-world experiments further demonstrate improved task success, including an increase from $20\%$ with standard FM to $80\%$ with TOPS on the upper-drawer opening task.

摘要（中文）：基于流的语言条件多任务操作策略通常共享单一的高斯源先验和跨任务的线性传输路径。然而，对于共享策略而言，可靠执行具有不同运动需求的多个任务仍具挑战性。我们提出**TOPS**（**任**务**导**向先验与**调**度），该方法在不修改网络架构的前提下，将流源先验和插值调度分别适配至每个任务。TOPS首先从反向映射的专家动作序列中构建多模态任务源，使语言指令能够选择生成的起始位置。随后，在源-目标协方差不匹配的引导下，TOPS在去噪早期放慢向专家动作的过渡，并在需要扩展的方向上加速后期过渡。在高斯端点模型下，我们的分析表明，这种调度调整可以降低速度预测风险的上界。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和CALVIN上的实验表明，TOPS在分布内、扰动及跨环境场景中均提升了性能，同时具备更高的数据效率。仅使用单步积分，TOPS即将LIBERO-10的成功率从十步标准流匹配（FM）的$53.44\%$提升至$69.67\%$，同时将推理时间缩减至基线的约六分之一。将TOPS迁移至大规模基于流的$π_{0.5}$策略时，在全部四个评估场景中均取得一致增益。真实世界实验进一步验证了任务成功率的提升，其中上抽屉开启任务的成功率从标准FM的$20\%$提升至TOPS的$80\%$。

Authors: Tuo An, Chuhao Zhou, Jiahua Dong, Jingliang Li, Jiaqi Bai, Jindou Jia, Jianfei Yang

RoboSTD: Zero-Shot Single-to-Dual Transfer via Sagittal Mirroring for Bimanual Learning Manipulation

Zero-shot transfer Bimanual manipulation Sagittal mirroring LLM-based coordination Single-to-dual

简要说明：RoboSTD 提出了一种零样本方法，通过矢状面镜像和 LLM 生成的协调约束将单臂操作演示转换为双臂伪演示，从而无需额外双臂数据即可学习双臂策略。

TLDR: RoboSTD proposes a zero-shot method to convert single-arm manipulation demonstrations into bimanual pseudo-demonstrations using sagittal-plane mirroring and LLM-generated coordination constraints, enabling bimanual policy learning without extra bimanual data.

Abstract: Bimanual robot manipulation plays an important role in real-world robotic applications, but the high cost of collecting bimanual demonstrations limits the scalable development of bimanual policy learning. Meanwhile, existing single-arm manipulation data are difficult to directly transfer to bimanual systems due to the Single-to-Dual gap in action spaces, coordination requirements, and arm-side spatial preference. To address this issue, we propose RoboSTD, a zero-shot Single-to-Dual data construction method for bimanual robot learning. RoboSTD first applies sagittal-plane mirroring to observations, proprioception, and actions to construct executable contralateral pseudo-demonstrations. It then uses an LLM to generate structured spatio-temporal coordination constraints that guide the reconstruction of pseudo-bimanual supervision across workspace regions and task stages. We evaluate RoboSTD on the AgileX ALOHA platform in both RoboTwin simulation and real-world settings. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of RoboSTD for bimanual policy learning. Without requiring additional bimanual demonstrations, RoboSTD increases the average number of collected cups to 2.11x that of the single-arm baseline in the cup collection task. Project page: https://huahungy.github.io/RoboSTD/

摘要（中文）：双臂机器人操作在现实世界的机器人应用中扮演着重要角色，但采集双臂示范数据的高昂成本限制了双臂策略学习的规模化发展。与此同时，由于动作空间中的单臂到双臂差异、协调性要求以及臂侧空间偏好等问题，现有的单臂操作数据难以直接迁移至双臂系统。为解决这一问题，我们提出了RoboSTD，一种面向双臂机器人学习的零样本单臂到双臂数据构建方法。RoboSTD首先对观测、本体感觉和动作应用矢状面镜像，以构建可执行的对侧伪示范数据。随后，它利用大语言模型生成结构化的时空协调约束，指导在工作空间区域和任务阶段中重建伪双臂监督信号。我们在AgileX ALOHA平台上，于RoboTwin仿真环境和真实世界场景中评估了RoboSTD。实验证明了RoboSTD在双臂策略学习中的有效性。在不额外采集双臂示范数据的情况下，RoboSTD在杯子收集任务中使收集杯子的平均数量达到单臂基线的2.11倍。项目主页：https://huahungy.github.io/RoboSTD/

Authors: Hongyu Wu, Chong Liu, Shaoxuan Xie, Shaqi Luo, Hanyu Feng, Shihan Wu, Guocai Yao

Mimetic Embodiment Transfer of Human-Humanoid Interaction from In-the-Wild Videos HumanoidEmbodied

human-humanoid interaction mimetic embodiment transfer motion retargeting contact preservation humanoid motion generation

简要说明：HumiTransfer将野外人与人交互视频转化为物理上可行的人-人形机器人交互，保持体间空间、语义和接触关系，并支持多种人形机器人的实际部署。

TLDR: HumiTransfer converts in-the-wild human-human interaction videos into physically plausible human-humanoid interactions, preserving inter-body spatial, semantic, and contact relationships, and supports real-robot deployment on multiple humanoid embodiments.

Abstract: Enabling a humanoid to interact naturally with human partners requires preserving not only individual motions but also the spatial, semantic, and contact relationships underlying the interaction (i.e., hugging, dancing, hand-shaking, etc.). Furthermore, a practical solution should generalize across various humanoid embodiments with distinct morphologies and kinematic constraints. To tackle this challenge, we propose HumiTransfer, a mimetic embodiment transfer framework that converts in-the-wild human-human interaction videos into physically plausible human-humanoid interactions. HumiTransfer first reconstructs 3D human motion with consistent foot-ground contact, then transfers one participant to a target humanoid embodiment via interaction modeling, using weighted joint-relative directions and anatomical offsets to prioritize interaction-critical inter-body relationships, while post-retargeting optimization enforces balance, contact, and collision avoidance. Subsequently, we apply HumiTransfer to 1,200 in-the-wild videos, producing approximately 500,000 frames of diverse interactions for the 26-DoF Unitree R1 Edu and the 23-DoF HighTorque Mini-hi humanoid robot, resulting in our HumiMimic dataset. Across both robots, HumiTransfer achieves superior motion fidelity, preserves inter-body relationships, and maintains contact accuracy compared with existing baselines. Moreover, we demonstrate that HumiMimic supports motion generation methods for synthesizing interactive humanoid motions following a human partner. Finally, our real robot deployments confirm the physical executability of the transferred motions in real-world settings.

摘要（中文）：摘要：实现人形机器人与人类伙伴的自然互动，不仅需要保留个体动作，还需维持互动背后蕴含的空间、语义及接触关系（如拥抱、舞蹈、握手等）。此外，一种实用的解决方案还应能够适应具有不同形态和运动学约束的多种人形机器人平台。为应对这一挑战，我们提出HumiTransfer——一种模仿式具身迁移框架，旨在将真实环境中的人类-人类互动视频转化为物理上可行的人形机器人-人类互动。HumiTransfer首先重建具有一致足地接触的三维人体运动，随后通过互动建模将其中一名参与者迁移至目标人形机器人平台，采用加权关节相对方向和解剖学偏移量来优先保留互动关键的人体间空间关系，并通过重定向后的优化确保平衡、接触和碰撞规避。随后，我们将HumiTransfer应用于1200段真实场景视频，生成了约50万帧多样化互动数据，涵盖26自由度Unitree R1 Edu和23自由度HighTorque Mini-hi两款人形机器人，从而构建了HumiMimic数据集。在两款机器人上，与现有基线方法相比，HumiTransfer在运动保真度、人体间关系保持和接触准确性方面均表现更优。此外，我们验证了HumiMimic能够支持运动生成方法，用于合成跟随人类伙伴的互动式人形机器人动作。最后，我们在真实机器人上的部署实验证实了迁移动作在实际环境中的物理可执行性。

Authors: Nghia Le, Khang Nguyen, Ba Long Tran, Thi Quynh Nhu Pham, Binh Nguyen, Tuong Do, Erman Tjiputra, Hoan Nguyen, Tung D. Ta, Baoru Huang, Hai-Nguyen, Nguyen, Anh Nguyen

REACH: An RL-based Hierarchical Humanoid Crawling Framework for Adaptable Confined Space Traversal HumanoidEmbodied

hierarchical RL humanoid locomotion confined space traversal crawling LiDAR-based planning

简要说明：REACH 提出了一种分层强化学习框架，使 Unitree G1 人形机器人能够通过变高度双足行走和爬行穿越受限空间，并利用 LiDAR 规划器实现无碰撞路径，已在实际环境中验证。

TLDR: REACH introduces a hierarchical RL framework enabling a Unitree G1 humanoid to traverse confined spaces via variable-height bipedal walking and crawling, with a LiDAR-based planner for collision-free paths and real-world validation.

Abstract: Humanoid locomotion in confined spaces requires continuous height adaptation across multiple locomotion modes, yet most existing approaches remain limited to height-adjustable bipedal walking. We present REACH, an RL-based hierarchical framework that enables a Unitree G1 humanoid to traverse height-constrained environments through variable-height bipedal walking and crawling. The learned policies regulate body height over complementary command ranges of 1.27--0.50m in bipedal locomotion and 0.50--0.20m in crawling, extending traversal beyond the clearance limits of crouched walking. To address contact-rich crawling dynamics, we employ a history-conditioned latent representation that captures terrain and interaction context from proprioceptive observations. A bidirectional transition policy further connects crouched bipedal locomotion and crawling across large kinematic and contact discontinuities. These skills are integrated with a LiDAR-based planner that converts point clouds into collision-free three-dimensional paths and locomotion commands, including proactive height targets. Real-world experiments demonstrate accurate height and velocity tracking, robust terrain traversal, reliable mode transitions and confined-space traversal with the proposed pipeline. Code and videos are available at https://aislab-sustech.github.io/REACH/.

摘要（中文）：在受限空间内的人形机器人移动要求跨越多种移动模式进行连续高度自适应，然而现有方法大多仍局限于可调高度的双足行走。我们提出了REACH，一种基于强化学习的分层框架，使Unitree G1人形机器人能够通过变高度双足行走和爬行穿越高度受限环境。学习到的策略在双足移动中调节身体高度至互补指令范围1.27—0.50m，在爬行中调节至0.50—0.20m，从而将穿越能力拓展至低于蹲姿行走净空极限的范围。为应对接触丰富的爬行动力学，我们采用一种基于历史状态的潜变量表示，从本体感觉观测中捕捉地形和交互上下文。一种双向转换策略进一步连接了蹲姿双足移动与爬行，跨越了大的运动学和接触不连续性。这些技能与基于LiDAR的规划器集成，该规划器将点云转换为无碰撞的三维路径和移动指令，包括前瞻性高度目标。真实世界实验展示了所提管线在精确高度与速度跟踪、稳健地形穿越、可靠模式转换及受限空间穿越方面的性能。代码和视频可在 https://aislab-sustech.github.io/REACH/ 获取。

Authors: Shengzhang Xu, Yuning Guo, Weiyi Hu, Yifeng Xu, Zhongyu Li, He Kong

CARD: Contact-Anchored Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation Manipulation

contact-aware retargeting dexterous manipulation tactile tracking human demonstrations force targets

简要说明：CARD 提出了一种以接触为锚定的重定向框架，通过保持接触力目标将人类演示转化为机器人动作，提高了多源数据下的灵巧操作成功率，并通过触觉跟踪控制器支持硬件回放。

TLDR: CARD introduces a contact-anchored retargeting framework that preserves contact force targets from human demonstrations to robot actions, improving dexterous manipulation success across various data sources and enabling hardware replay via a tactile tracking controller.

Abstract: Humans are dexterous, but traditional data collection paradigms such as teleoperation, kinesthetic teaching, and wearable exoskeletons force humans to act through the robot embodiment, bottlenecking their dexterity. Retargeting can avoid this. However, existing methods purely translate kinematics and ignore the real-world contact dynamics essential for task success. We present CARD: Contact-Anchored Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation, a simulator and object-free framework that retargets human demonstrations to robot actions by explicitly preserving contact force targets. CARD unifies human data sources including video, motion capture, and tactile gloves via a shared hand--contact representation and generates explicit contact force targets in addition to kinematics. To maintain these contact targets during hardware open-loop replay, CARD also introduces a tactile tracking controller. For video which does not contain an explicit tactile source, we present Vid-HACO, our video-to-contact model that sets a new state of the art. Across our video, glove, motion-capture data and the GRAB dataset, CARD maintains contact on $43$--$78\%$ of contact frames, while kinematic and object-aware retargeting methods maintain contact on $<10\%$ and $22.5\%$ of the frames respectively. Further, integrating our formulation into physics-based retargeting improves strict task success from 12\% to 32\% on GRAB dataset. Finally, we show that our tactile tracker is critical to reproduce demonstrated forces during hardware replay. These results establish that contact preservation via CARD is a scalable interface for transferring human dexterity to robots.

摘要（中文）：人类灵巧非凡，但传统的数据采集范式，如远程操作、动能教学和可穿戴外骨骼，迫使人类通过机器人本体来行动，从而限制了其灵巧性的发挥。重定向技术则可避免这一问题。然而，现有方法仅纯粹地转换运动学信息，忽略了对于任务成功至关重要的真实接触动力学。我们提出了CARD：面向灵巧操作的接触锚定重定向框架，这是一个无需模拟器及物体的框架，通过显式保留接触力目标，将人类示范重定向为机器人动作。CARD通过共享的手-接触表示统一了包括视频、动作捕捉和触觉手套在内的人类数据源，并生成除运动学之外的显式接触力目标。为在硬件开环回放过程中维持这些接触目标，CARD还引入了一种触觉跟踪控制器。对于不含显式触觉源的视频，我们提出了Vid-HACO，这是一种视频到接触的模型，达到了当前最先进的水平。在我们的视频、手套、动作捕捉数据及GRAB数据集上，CARD在43%至78%的接触帧上保持了接触，而运动学重定向和物体感知重定向方法分别在不到10%和22.5%的帧上保持了接触。此外，将我们的公式整合到基于物理的重定向中，使得GRAB数据集上的严格任务成功率从12%提升至32%。最后，我们展示了触觉跟踪器对于在硬件回放过程中再现示范力的关键作用。这些结果表明，通过CARD实现接触保持，是向机器人迁移人类灵巧性的可扩展接口。

Authors: Cunxi Dai, Botao He, Francois R Hogan, Wei Pan, Rao Fu, Wen-Han Hsieh, Ruoshi Liu, Jitendra Malik, Guanya Shi, Akash Sharma

A Trainable CPG Framework for Quadruped Locomotion Locomotion

central pattern generator quadruped locomotion gait transitions feedback policy Unitree Go2

简要说明：本文提出了CPG-ENN，一种四足运动框架，结合基于对称性的CPG产生步态节律与学习执行网络及反馈策略实现速度/偏航跟踪，仿真跨步态转换成功率高，并在Unitree Go2机器人上验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces CPG-ENN, a quadruped locomotion framework combining a symmetry-based CPG for gait rhythm generation with a learned execution network and a feedback policy for velocity/yaw tracking, achieving high cross-gait transition success in simulation and validated on a Unitree Go2 robot.

Abstract: We present CPG-ENN, a trainable quadruped locomotion framework that combines explicit neural coordination with learned motion realization. A symmetry-based eight-neuron central pattern generator (CPG) supplies gait rhythms, while a pretrained, leg-shared execution neural network (ENN) maps rhythmic signals and trajectory parameters to joint-angle references without online inverse kinematics. A single feedback policy modulates six physically interpretable trajectory variables. The controller tracks planar velocity and yaw-rate commands across walk, trot, pace, bound, and pronk without gait-specific learned controllers or transitionspecific rewards. Simulation yields 99.39% transition success across all 20 directed gait pairs and all source-target speed combinations from {0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0} m/s. Ablations show high cross-gait transition feasibility without transition exposure; exposure mainly refines gait acquisition and velocity transients. Comparisons with AllGaits and Walk These Ways demonstrate accurate gait-speed regulation, and Unitree Go2 experiments validate five gaits and their transitions.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了CPG-ENN，一个可训练的四足运动框架，将显式神经协调与学习到的运动实现相结合。一个基于对称性的八神经元中央模式发生器（CPG）提供步态节律，而一个预训练的、腿部共享的执行神经网络（ENN）将节律信号和轨迹参数映射为关节角度参考值，无需在线逆运动学计算。一个单一的反馈策略调节六个具有物理可解释性的轨迹变量。该控制器能够在行走、小跑、溜步、跳跃和弹跳五种步态下跟踪平面速度与偏航角速度指令，无需步态特定的学习控制器或转换特定的奖励。仿真实验在全部20个定向步态对以及所有来自{0.5，1.0，1.5, 2.0} m/s的源-目标速度组合中，实现了99.39%的转换成功率。消融实验表明，在没有转换暴露的情况下，跨步态转换可行性很高；暴露主要优化了步态习得和速度瞬态响应。与AllGaits及Walk These Ways方法的对比验证了精确的步态-速度调节能力，Unitree Go2实验则验证了五种步态及其转换的有效性。

Authors: Xiyan Liu, Yide Liu, Guoyong Mao, Shaoxing Qu

GRAFT: Geometry-Aware Residual Adaptation for Foundation Trackers HumanoidEmbodied

residual adaptation behavior foundation models terrain adaptation humanoid locomotion frozen trackers

简要说明：GRAFT 为冻结的人形行为基础模型追踪器引入轻量级、地形条件化的残差适配器，使其无需重新训练或修改基础追踪器即可穿越复杂地形。适配器通过任务和脚部几何奖励训练，在平地正则化，并从特权地形观测蒸馏到机载深度，在仿真和真实 Unitree G1 机器人上得到验证。

TLDR: GRAFT introduces a lightweight, terrain-conditioned residual adapter for frozen humanoid behavior foundation model trackers, enabling them to traverse complex terrain without retraining or modifying the base tracker. The adapter is trained with task and foot-geometry rewards, regularized for flat ground, and distilled from privileged terrain observations to onboard depth, validated in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 robot.

Abstract: Humanoid behavior foundation models (BFMs) provide reusable whole-body motion priors: given a kinematic reference, they generate coordinated joint commands for motion replay, teleoperation, and VLA control. However, trained primarily on flat-ground motion, BFMs lack an explicit mechanism to adapt foot placement, swing clearance, and contact timing to local terrain. Many terrain-aware BFM approaches address this limitation by retraining or fine-tuning the tracker together with perception, incurring substantial data and computation costs while coupling ordinary tracking to the perception pathway. To bridge this gap, we propose GRAFT, a geometry-aware residual adaptation framework for frozen behavior trackers. GRAFT preserves the BFM parameters and motion-reference interface, while a lightweight adapter adds terrain-conditioned corrections only to lower-body execution targets. The adapter is trained with task and foot-geometry rewards, regularized to suppress unnecessary corrections on flat ground, and distilled from privileged terrain observations to onboard depth. Because the frozen BFM already provides whole-body reference tracking and nominal locomotion, GRAFT reduces terrain learning to a focused execution-adaptation problem. We instantiate the framework on four frozen trackers and evaluate stairs, gaps, and platforms in simulation. We further validate it through real-world deployment on a Unitree G1, where the adapted SONIC tracker traverses terrain with onboard depth and unmodified references.

摘要（中文）：类人行为基础模型（BFMs）提供了可复用的全身运动先验：给定运动学参考，它们能够生成协调的关节指令，用于运动重放、遥操作和VLA控制。然而，由于主要在平地运动数据上训练，BFMs缺乏将足部落点、摆动离地高度和接触时序适应局部地形的显式机制。许多地形感知型BFM方法通过将跟踪器与感知一起重训练或微调来解决这一局限，但此举带来了大量数据和计算成本，同时将普通跟踪与感知通路耦合在一起。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了GRAFT——一种面向冻结行为跟踪器的几何感知残差自适应框架。GRAFT保留了BFM参数和运动参考接口，而一个轻量级适配器仅对下半身执行目标添加地形条件化的修正。该适配器通过任务奖励和足部几何奖励进行训练，并通过正则化抑制平地上的不必要修正，同时从特权地形观测中蒸馏到机载深度信息。由于冻结的BFM已经提供了全身参考跟踪和标称运动能力，GRAFT将地形学习简化为一个聚焦的执行自适应问题。我们在四个冻结跟踪器上实例化了该框架，并在仿真中评估了楼梯、间隙和平台场景。我们进一步通过Unitree G1上的真实世界部署验证了该方法，其中适配后的SONIC跟踪器利用机载深度和未修改的参考成功穿越了复杂地形。
