Authors: Philip Huang, Fabio Ramos, Jiaoyang Li, Caelan Garrett, Lars Johannsmeier

Understanding the limits of latent world models WorldModel

latent world models faithful latent rollout consistency equivariance action-conditioned prediction

简要说明：本文提出潜在世界模型的忠实性概念以及潜变量滚动一致性（LRC）指标，用以评估潜在世界模型是否真正学习环境的预测动力学，结果发现现有最先进模型均未忠实地建模环境动态。

TLDR: This paper proposes faithful latent world models and a latent rollout consistency (LRC) metric to evaluate whether latent world models truly learn predictive dynamics, finding that current state-of-the-art models fail to faithfully model environment dynamics.

Abstract: World models are widely proposed as core components for enabling agents to reason over long temporal and spatial horizons. Yet current evaluations often emphasize task performance while providing limited insight into whether learned world models acquire predictive latent dynamics that reflect the underlying structure of the environment. Here we introduce the concept of faithful latent world models as an equivariance condition between the environment's transition map and the learned latent dynamics. We propose latent rollout consistency (LRC) as a metric to evaluate action-conditioned latent prediction. Strikingly, we find that across the studied state of the art latent world models, none solves the task by actually faithfully modeling the dynamics of the environment.

摘要（中文）：世界模型被广泛提出作为使代理能够在长时间和空间跨度上进行推理的核心组件。然而，当前的评估往往侧重于任务表现，而对于所学世界模型是否获得了反映环境潜在结构的预测性潜在动态，提供的洞察却十分有限。在此，我们引入忠实潜在世界模型的概念，将其定义为环境转移映射与所学潜在动态之间的等变性条件。我们提出潜在展开一致性（LRC）作为评估动作条件潜在预测的指标。值得注意的是，我们发现，在所研究的最先进的潜在世界模型中，没有一种模型通过真正忠实地建模环境动态来解决任务。

Authors: Rodrigo Gonzalez Laiz, Steffen Schneider

Representing the Unseen: Rethinking Visual Imagination for Spatial Reasoning WorldModel

spatial reasoning visual imagination world models representation selection simulator-grounded benchmark

简要说明：本文提出了一个基准和方法，研究不同视觉表征（RGB、深度、全景、俯视）对想象状态空间推理的影响，表明仅用RGB不足，自适应选择表征可提升推理。

TLDR: The paper introduces a benchmark and a method to study how different visual representations (RGB, depth, panoramic, top-down) affect spatial reasoning from imagined states, showing that RGB alone is insufficient and adaptive representation selection improves reasoning.

Abstract: Visual world models increasingly support spatial reasoning by generating RGB views of unobserved states. However, RGB has become the default interface largely because it is well suited for visual generation, rather than necessarily being the most effective representation for downstream reasoning. Different spatial questions may benefit from different representations of the same imagined state: top-down geometry can facilitate global distance comparisons, while panoramic views provide broader context for reasoning about open space. To isolate the role of representation in spatial imagination, we introduce ImagiRep, a simulator-grounded benchmark of 922 questions spanning seven question types across two settings, Viewpoint Imagination and Cross-view Integration, providing oracle RGB and six alternative representations (e.g., depth, panoramic views, and top-down geometry) of the same unobserved state. This controlled comparison reveals that even accurate imagined RGB does not guarantee accurate spatial reasoning, and different questions benefit from different representations. Similar trends hold for representations derived from world-model-estimated states. Notably, estimated RGB alone can mislead spatial reasoning, while alternative representations retain complementary benefits. Building on these findings, we introduce GEARS, a lightweight test-time strategy for adaptive representation selection, outperforming existing spatial imagination methods and showing that reasoning about unseen states requires more than generating RGB views.

摘要（中文）：视觉世界模型日益通过生成未观测状态的RGB视图来支持空间推理。然而，RGB之所以成为默认接口，很大程度上是因为它更适用于视觉生成，而非必然是最有利于下游推理的表示形式。不同的空间问题可能受益于同一想象状态的不同表示：俯视几何有助于全局距离比较，而全景视图则为开放空间推理提供更广泛的上下文。为隔离表示在空间想象中的作用，我们引入了ImagiRep，一个基于模拟器的基准测试，包含922个问题，涵盖两种设置（视角想象与跨视图整合）下的七种问题类型，为同一未观测状态提供oracle RGB及六种替代表示（如深度图、全景视图和俯视几何）。这一受控比较揭示，即使想象的RGB完全准确，也不能保证空间推理的准确性，且不同类型的问题受益于不同的表示形式。由世界模型估计状态导出的表示也呈现类似趋势。值得注意的是，仅靠估计的RGB可能误导空间推理，而替代表示则保留互补优势。基于这些发现，我们提出了GEARS，一种轻量级的测试时自适应表示选择策略，其性能优于现有空间想象方法，并表明对未见状态的推理所需远不止生成RGB视图。

Authors: Zengqi Zhao, Zun Wang, Shoubin Yu, Mohit Bansal, Yue Zhang

Zooming without Zooming v2: From Seeing Details to Connecting Evidence for Generalizable Multimodal Perception Perception3D

multimodal perception evidence connection spatial reasoning data synthesis RLVR

简要说明：本文提出EvidenceConnect数据合成框架，通过训练VLM连接图像局部区域的视觉证据，提升了具身空间推理、多模态长上下文理解和智能体任务的泛化性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces EvidenceConnect, a data synthesis framework that trains VLMs to connect visual evidence from zoomed regions, improving performance on embodied spatial reasoning, multimodal long-context understanding, and agent tasks without task-specific data.

Abstract: Multimodal perception forms the foundation of multimodal intelligence. In particular, spatial perception and multimodal long-context understanding are two pivotal tasks that underpin embodied AI and multimodal agents. However, synthesizing targeted, high-quality training data for these tasks remains difficult and costly. Our key insight is that these tasks share an underlying capability, which we call connecting evidence: identifying relevant visual facts, binding them to the correct entities, recovering their relations, and composing them into an answer. Crucially, targeted training data are far easier to synthesize for this capability than for these tasks themselves. To strengthen this capability, we propose EvidenceConnect, an easy-to-implement data synthesis framework that uses zoomed views of related regions within a single image to generate questions requiring comparison, aggregation, or chaining of visual evidence. To ensure quality, a reference answer is retained only when independent VLMs agree on it, and region-ablation tests discard questions whose answer survives the removal of selected regions. We then train base VLMs on the resulting data with RLVR, obtaining Zooming without Zooming v2 (ZwZ2). Although the synthesized data are not tailored to any downstream benchmark, ZwZ2 improves fine-grained and spatial perception, with further gains on embodied spatial reasoning, multimodal long-context understanding, multimodal agent tasks, and general visual reasoning. These results establish EvidenceConnect as an effective framework for supervising evidence connection and suggest that strengthening this shared capability leads to more generalizable multimodal perception.

摘要（中文）：多模态感知构成多模态智能的基础。其中，空间感知与多模态长上下文理解是支撑具身智能和多模态智能体的两项关键任务。然而，为这些任务合成针对性、高质量的训练数据仍然困难且成本高昂。我们的核心洞察在于，这些任务共享一种底层能力，我们称之为“证据连接”：识别相关视觉事实，将其绑定到正确的实体，恢复实体间的关系，并将这些信息整合为答案。关键在于，针对这一能力合成训练数据远比针对任务本身合成数据容易得多。为强化该能力，我们提出EvidenceConnect——一种易于实现的数据合成框架，利用单张图像内相关区域的缩放视图来生成需要视觉证据比较、聚合或串联的问题。为确保质量，仅当多个独立视觉语言模型对参考答案达成一致时才予以保留，同时通过区域消融测试剔除那些在移除选定区域后答案仍然成立的问题。随后，我们使用强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）在生成的数据上训练基础视觉语言模型，得到Zooming without Zooming v2（ZwZ2）。尽管合成数据并非针对任何下游基准定制，ZwZ2仍显著提升了细粒度与空间感知能力，并在具身空间推理、多模态长上下文理解、多模态智能体任务及通用视觉推理方面取得了进一步增益。这些结果确立了EvidenceConnect作为证据连接监督的有效框架，并表明强化这一共享能力可带来更具泛化性的多模态感知。

Authors: Lai Wei, Yatai Li, Liangbo He, Jun Lan, Renjie Gu, Linhan Cao, Junkai Lin, Huijia Zhu, Weiqiang Wang, Linghe Kong, Yue Wang, Zhuosheng Zhang, Weiran Huang

Vision-Language Agents Can Learn in Their Own Latent Worlds VLA

model-based RL vision-language model latent world model continual learning latent imagination

简要说明：Dwell将预训练VLM作为循环潜在转移算子，用于基于模型的强化学习，使智能体能够从真实交互和潜在想象中持续学习而无需重建未来，在五个交互式视觉环境中以更低计算量取得强性能。

TLDR: Dwell frames a pretrained VLM as a recurrent latent transition operator for model-based RL, enabling continual learning from real interactions and latent imagination without reconstructing the future, achieving strong performance across five interactive visual environments with reduced compute.

Abstract: Learning from experience is essential for building the next generation of agents that continually expand their capabilities. Pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) already internalize rich world knowledge, yet this knowledge is rarely leveraged to drive policy improvement through online interaction. Realizing this potential efficiently remains challenging, as policy updates shift the agent's interaction distribution, requiring the world model to adapt accordingly, while continually updating large pretrained models is computationally expensive. To address this challenge, we introduce Dwell, a model-based reinforcement learning (RL) framework that reframes a VLM as a recurrent latent transition operator, endowing it with the ability to predict, adjust, and act in latent space. Leveraging the VLM's own representations and its dual role as both world model and policy, the agent continually learns from real interactions to anticipate and evaluate action outcomes, and from latent imagination to improve its behavior. Across five interactive visual environments, Dwell achieves the strongest overall performance among trainable methods while substantially reducing the compute required for imagination, showing that effective world models for VLM agents need not reconstruct the future; they need to predict futures that are useful for action. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Tom111-lhx/Dwell

摘要（中文）：从经验中学习对于构建能够持续扩展能力的下一代智能体至关重要。预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）已经内化了丰富的世界知识，但这些知识很少被利用来通过在线交互驱动策略改进。高效实现这一潜力仍然具有挑战性，因为策略更新会改变智能体的交互分布，要求世界模型相应调整，而持续更新大型预训练模型在计算上代价高昂。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了Dwell，一种基于模型的强化学习（RL）框架，将视觉-语言模型重新构建为循环隐式转移算子，赋予其在隐空间中预测、调整和行动的能力。利用VLM自身的表示及其作为世界模型和策略的双重角色，智能体持续从真实交互中学习以预测和评估行动结果，并通过隐式想象来改进其行为。在五个交互式视觉环境中，Dwell在可训练方法中取得了最强的整体性能，同时大幅减少了想象所需的计算量，表明有效的VLM智能体世界模型无需重建未来；它们需要预测的是对行动有用的未来。我们的代码公开于 https://github.com/Tom111-lhx/Dwell

Authors: Haoxi Li, Sikai Bai, Jianfei Ma, Qinglin Hou, Xiaocheng Lu, Tao Han, Jie Zhang, Song Guo

Evaluation-Guided Demonstration Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Policies: The Winning Entry in the MetaFine Open Competition VLA

Vision-Language-Action policies demonstration refinement fine-tuning manipulation competition

简要说明：本文介绍了MetaFine开放竞赛中的获胜方法，即为每个任务微调独立的VLA策略，并根据局部评估反馈改进演示以修复常见故障，最终获得96.66分。

TLDR: The paper describes the winning approach in the MetaFine Open Competition, which fine-tunes separate VLA policies per task and refines demonstrations based on local evaluation feedback to fix recurring failures, achieving a score of 96.66.

Abstract: We fine-tuned a separate $π_{0.5}$ policy for each of the five tasks in the MetaFine Open Competition, with a task-specific training mixture and number of actions executed per prediction. Training started from the official demonstrations and expert procedures. Local evaluation exposed recurring grasping, pushing, and insertion failures. We addressed them by revising the demonstrated motions and by adding expert continuations from states the policy reached, while keeping nominal demonstrations in training. Checkpoints were compared on every instruction, so that a gain on one instruction could not hide a loss on another. Our submission, MAI, ranked first overall with a score of 96.66.

摘要（中文）：我们针对MetaFine公开竞赛中的五个任务，分别为每个任务微调了一个独立的\( \pi_{0.5} \)策略，采用了针对特定任务的训练混合数据以及每次预测执行的动作数量。训练从官方演示和专家流程开始。局部评估暴露了反复出现的抓取、推动和插入失败问题。我们通过修改演示动作，并从策略所达到的状态中添加专家延续步骤，同时将标准演示保留在训练中，解决了这些问题。我们对每个指令的检查点进行了比较，以确保一个指令上的改进不会掩盖另一个指令上的退步。我们的提交方案MAI以96.66的总分排名第一。

Authors: Lifan Zheng, Guotao Chen, Zhenyang Li, Shujie Cui, Qiang Huang, Fan Liu

BoxWorld: Let World Engines Control and Video Generators Render WorldModel

interactive video worlds world engines state-aware video generation object grounding rollout distillation

简要说明：BoxWorld将交互推理（通过规则指定的Box World Engine）与生成式视频渲染分离，实现了具有用户定义对象级行为的实时交互视频世界，并在交互控制基准上优于端到端世界模型。

TLDR: BoxWorld separates interaction reasoning (via a rule-specified Box World Engine) from generative video rendering, enabling real-time interactive video worlds with user-defined object-level behaviors, and outperforms end-to-end world models on interaction control benchmarks.

Abstract: We tackle the challenge of building real-time interactive video worlds with user-defined behaviors. Such worlds must track object states, apply interaction rules, and render the resulting consequences as users act. Yet existing end-to-end video world models typically learn interaction dynamics within the generator, making it difficult to specify object-level rules and reason about their consequences. In this work, we introduce BoxWorld, which separates interaction reasoning from generative rendering. Given user-specified rules, a coding agent creates a Box World Engine that determines interaction outcomes and exposes the resulting object states through a lightweight interface of layout boxes, persistent object attributes, and dynamic status variables, leaving appearance and physical effects to generative rendering. A Box-State Generative Renderer then renders this evolving state stream into video autoregressively, enabling online control over object motion, state switches, and conditional events. Rendering this state stream is non-trivial: the renderer must respond to object-level state updates in real time while remaining coherent with the generated history. To this end, we introduce a three-stage training strategy that learns object grounding from open-domain videos and state transitions from gameplay videos, both annotated automatically, and finally performs rollout distillation on self-generated histories. We further propose PairedStateBench, a paired benchmark for fine-grained interaction control. BoxWorld substantially outperforms end-to-end world models and remains competitive across multiple public benchmarks. Project page: https://boxworld-web.github.io.

摘要（中文）：我们致力于解决构建具备用户自定义行为的实时交互视频世界这一挑战。此类世界必须追踪对象状态、应用交互规则，并在用户操作时渲染相应的后果。然而，现有的端到端视频世界模型通常将交互动态学习内置于生成器中，这使得指定对象级规则并推理其后果变得困难。在本工作中，我们提出了BoxWorld，它将交互推理与生成式渲染相分离。根据用户指定的规则，一个编码智能体创建Box World引擎，该引擎确定交互结果，并通过轻量级接口（包括布局框、持久对象属性和动态状态变量）暴露所得的对象状态，而外观和物理效果则交由生成式渲染处理。随后，一个框状态生成式渲染器将这一不断演化的状态流自回归地渲染为视频，从而实现对对象运动、状态切换和条件事件的在线控制。渲染这一状态流并非易事：渲染器必须实时响应对象级状态更新，同时与已生成的历史保持连贯。为此，我们引入了一种三阶段训练策略，该策略从开放域视频中学习对象定位，从游戏视频中学习状态转换（两者均自动标注），最后在自生成的历史上进行展开蒸馏。我们进一步提出了PairedStateBench，一个用于细粒度交互控制的配对基准。BoxWorld显著优于端到端世界模型，并在多个公开基准上保持竞争力。项目页面：https://boxworld-web.github.io。

Authors: Zike Wu, Ahmed Hatem, Chintan Trivedi, Wallace Michel Pinto Lira, Xuebin Qin, Lele Wang, Renjie Liao

Hyperparameter and Neural Architecture Search via Evolutionary Optimization for Reinforcement Learning: HPNAS-RL AutonomousDriving

Neural Architecture Search Hyperparameter Optimization Evolutionary Optimization Reinforcement Learning Autonomous Driving

简要说明：本文提出了一种双分支进化框架，在自动驾驶强化学习策略中联合优化神经网络架构和超参数，实验表明其在模拟器中比单独NAS获得更高奖励、更少参数和更好的稳定性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a dual-branch evolutionary framework that jointly optimizes neural network architectures and hyperparameters for reinforcement learning policies in autonomous driving, demonstrating improved reward, efficiency, and stability over standalone NAS in a high-fidelity simulator.

Abstract: In this study, we propose a dual-branch evolutionary framework that simultaneously performs Neural Architecture Search (NAS) and Hyperparameter Optimization (HPO) for Reinforcement Learning (RL) in Autonomous Driving (AD) tasks. While NAS has shown strong potential in automating architecture design for Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), its application to RL remains limited, especially in scenarios that require joint optimization of architectural and training dynamics. Building on our prior work on Evolutionary Multi-Objective NAS (EMNAS), the proposed framework evolves discrete network architectures and continuous hyperparameters in parallel under a unified multi-objective search strategy. In this setup, NAS targets the convolutional layers of the RL policy network - responsible for visual feature extraction, while HPO focuses on optimizing critical RL hyperparameters. To accelerate convergence and improve generalization, we incorporate parallel evaluation and a teacher-student policy transfer mechanism. Experiments in a high-fidelity driving simulator show that the joint NAS-HPO framework consistently outperforms standalone NAS, yielding policies with higher rewards, fewer parameters, and improved stability. These results highlight the benefits of jointly optimizing model structure and training dynamics for scalable and effective RL agent design.

摘要（中文）：在本研究中，我们提出了一种双分支进化框架，该框架在自动驾驶任务中的强化学习（RL）中同时执行神经架构搜索（NAS）和超参数优化（HPO）。尽管NAS在自动化卷积神经网络（CNNs）架构设计方面展现出巨大潜力，但其在强化学习中的应用仍然有限，尤其是在需要联合优化架构与训练动态的场景中。基于我们先前在进化多目标神经架构搜索（EMNAS）方面的工作，所提出的框架在统一的多目标搜索策略下，并行进化离散网络架构和连续超参数。在此设置中，NAS针对强化学习策略网络中的卷积层——负责视觉特征提取——而HPO则专注于优化关键的强化学习超参数。为加速收敛并提升泛化能力，我们引入了并行评估和师生策略迁移机制。在高保真驾驶模拟器中的实验表明，联合NAS-HPO框架持续优于单独使用NAS的方法，生成的策略具有更高的奖励、更少的参数以及更好的稳定性。这些结果凸显了联合优化模型结构与训练动态对于可扩展且高效的强化学习智能体设计的优势。

pipe stabbing residual reinforcement learning stereo vision keypoint detection MuJoCo simulation

简要说明：StabBot利用学习到的立体视觉（ResNet-18关键点）和残差强化学习在石油钻井过程中预测管道摆动并匹配速度，在仿真中实现了100%的成功率，且接触力更低，对干扰具有鲁棒性，优于固定导向器。

TLDR: StabBot uses learned stereo vision (ResNet-18 keypoints) and residual reinforcement learning to predict pipe swing and match velocity during robotic pipe stabbing in oil drilling, achieving 100% success in simulation with lower contact forces and robustness to disturbances compared to a fixed guide.

Abstract: A joint of pipe run into the hole swings from the elevator over the well and strikes a fixed stabbing guide at whatever speed the swing has. StabBot, a robotic stabbing system, predicts the swing and meets the pipe at its own speed. A pendulum Kalman filter tuned from the pipe tally tracks the joint in stereo images. A six-axis arm with an open V-shaped roller head closes in at matched velocity, confirms the last millimetres by touch, aims the pin over the box when the elevator hangs off centre, and follows the block down with lateral compliance. A ResNet-18 keypoint network locates the pipe, pin nose and box mouth in 3-D, and a residual reinforcement-learning policy refines the capture. On 200 paired random jobs with nine sizes from 2-3/8-in. tubing to 20-in. casing, StabBot seated every joint with the pipe touching only rollers, against 74% for a conventional fixed guide. Median contact speed fell from 18.4 to 2.3 cm/s and median peak head-pipe force from 11.3 to 1.4 kN, and the force was lower in all 200 jobs (Wilcoxon $p < 10^{-30}$). The network locates the pipe with 0.4-mm median error in 2.3 ms per stereo pair. With the network in the loop, success stayed at 100% under 20 mm of added noise, 300-ms delay, 85% frame loss, 20-mm calibration offset, 20-cm elevator offset and 40-cm swings. All results come from a 1:4 Froude-scaled MuJoCo model and are reported at full scale.

摘要（中文）：摘要：下井管柱接头从井口上方的大钩中摆动，并以摆动速度撞击固定的对扣导向装置。StabBot（一种机器人对扣系统）可预测摆动，并以自身速度迎接管柱。基于管柱记录调校的摆锤卡尔曼滤波器在立体图像中跟踪接头。六轴机械臂配备开放式V形滚轮头，以匹配速度接近，通过触觉确认最后几毫米位置，在大钩偏心悬挂时将公扣对准母扣，并以横向柔顺性随游车下移。ResNet-18关键点网络在三维空间中定位管柱、公扣尖端和母扣口，残差强化学习策略进一步优化抓取动作。在200次成对随机作业中，涵盖从2-3/8英寸油管到20英寸套管的9种规格，StabBot在管柱仅接触滚轮的情况下实现了每次接头的成功对扣，而传统固定导向装置的成功率为74%。中位接触速度从18.4 cm/s降至2.3 cm/s，中位峰值头管力从11.3 kN降至1.4 kN，且在全部200次作业中该力均更低（Wilcoxon检验p < 10⁻³⁰）。该网络在每对立体图像上以2.3 ms的处理时间实现0.4 mm的中位定位误差。在加入20 mm噪声、300 ms延迟、85%帧丢失、20 mm标定偏移、20 cm大钩偏移及40 cm摆动的条件下，网络闭环下的成功率仍保持100%。所有结果均来自1:4弗劳德缩比MuJoCo模型，并以全尺寸报告。

Authors: Mohamed Ashraf Mostafa, Taher El-Fakharany, Samir Khaled

Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning of Co-Adaptive Hip Exoskeleton Control (MARL-Exo) for Metabolic Energy Reduction Locomotion

multi-agent reinforcement learning hip exoskeleton co-adaptation metabolic energy reduction sim-to-real transfer

简要说明：本文提出了MARL-Exo，一种多智能体强化学习框架，在仿真中与肌肉骨骼人体模型共同适应训练髋部外骨骼控制策略，并使用代谢能量奖励。该策略无需个体调参即可降低新用户的代谢成本，展示了成功的仿真到现实迁移。

TLDR: This paper introduces MARL-Exo, a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that co-adapts a hip-exoskeleton control policy with a musculoskeletal human model in simulation, trained with a metabolic-energy reward. The learned policy reduces metabolic cost in new users without per-user tuning, demonstrating successful sim-to-real transfer.

Abstract: Objective: This study aims to determine whether a hip-exoskeleton policy trained in simulation, by co-adapting with a musculoskeletal human model under a metabolic-energy reward, reduces the metabolic cost of walking in new users without per-user tuning, and how mechanical-power shaping affects the learned assistance. Methods: We developed MARL-Exo, a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework in which a full-body human model (304 muscle actuators; randomized anatomy, gait, and speed) and a bilateral hip-exoskeleton policy are trained concurrently in two stages. The exoskeleton observes only delayed hip kinematics and its past commands; its reward includes muscle metabolic power from a physiologically based energetics model, alone (Metabolic) or with mechanical-power shaping (Metabolic + Power). The Metabolic policy was deployed and tested without retraining in eight healthy adults walking at 1.25 m/s, using indirect calorimetry. Results: In simulation, the Metabolic policy reduced modeled muscle metabolic power by 13.8% relative to no-device walking, versus 8.8% for Metabolic + Power. On hardware, MARL-Exo reduced net metabolic rate by 18.3 $\pm$ 6.6% relative to Passive in all eight participants. Relative to No-Exo, the mean reduction was 7.4 $\pm$ 10.0%; six participants more than offset the 13.1% device-wearing penalty, walking up to 24.2% below their No-Exo cost. Conclusion: A metabolically informed policy co-adapted in simulation transferred to users without per-user tuning and consistently reduced the metabolic cost of walking with the device, while explicit power shaping reduced the simulated benefit. Significance: Unlike per-user human-in-the-loop optimization, this approach yields a single population-level controller and allows assistance objectives to be screened in simulation before human testing.

摘要（中文）：目的：本研究旨在探究在模拟环境中，通过肌肉骨骼人体模型与代谢能量奖励的协同适应训练得到的髋部外骨骼控制策略，能否在无需个体化调整的情况下，降低新用户行走的代谢能耗，并分析机械功率塑形对学习到的辅助模式有何影响。方法：我们开发了MARL-Exo，一种多智能体强化学习框架，其中包含全身人体模型（304个肌肉驱动器；随机化解剖结构、步态和速度）和双侧髋部外骨骼控制策略，两者分两个阶段同步训练。外骨骼仅观察延迟的髋部运动学信息及其历史指令；其奖励包括基于生理能量模型的肌肉代谢功率，单独使用（代谢组）或结合机械功率塑形（代谢+功率组）。代谢组策略在未经重新训练的情况下，部署并测试于8名健康成年人以1.25 m/s速度行走的场景中，采用间接测热法评估效果。结果：在模拟中，代谢组策略相比无设备行走，将模型肌肉代谢功率降低了13.8%，而代谢+功率组仅降低了8.8%。在硬件实验中，MARL-Exo使所有8名参与者的净代谢率相比被动组降低了18.3 ± 6.6%。相比无外骨骼组，平均降低幅度为7.4 ± 10.0%；其中6名参与者不仅完全抵消了13.1%的设备穿戴负担，其代谢能耗甚至低于无外骨骼状态，最高降幅达24.2%。结论：在模拟中协同适应得到的代谢信息驱动策略，无需个体化调整即可迁移至实际使用者，并持续降低穿戴设备行走的代谢能耗；而显式的功率塑形反而削弱了模拟中的辅助收益。意义：与依赖个体在环优化的方法不同，本方法能够生成单一群体级控制策略，并允许在人体测试之前，于模拟环境中对辅助目标进行筛选评估。

Authors: Yifei Yuan, Jakob Wolf, Ghaith Androwis, Xianlian Zhou

AuRaSim: A Ray-Tracing Based Automotive FMCW Radar Simulator for Dynamic Scenarios AutonomousDriving

ray-tracing radar simulation FMCW radar ADC cube synthesis dynamic scenario simulation digital twin

简要说明：AuRaSim 是一个基于光线追踪的汽车 FMCW 雷达模拟器，适用于动态场景，基于 Blender 和 Sionna RT 构建，可合成相干 ADC 数据立方体，并在数字孪生场景中与实测数据进行了验证。

TLDR: AuRaSim is a ray-tracing-based automotive FMCW radar simulator for dynamic scenarios, built on Blender and Sionna RT, that can synthesize coherent ADC cubes and is validated against measured data in digital-twin scenarios.

Abstract: Modern simulators can generate synthetic camera and LiDAR data with accurate annotations for downstream tasks. In contrast, automotive radar simulation remains less mature because it requires not only a 3D engine to model dynamic objects in the scenes but also electromagnetic material properties, antenna configurations, wave propagation mechanisms, and coherent signal synthesis. Existing frameworks are either proprietary or overly simplified, limiting the scalability of radar raw measurements. This paper presents AuRaSim, a ray-tracing-based automotive frequency-modulated continuous wave (FMCW) radar simulation framework for dynamic scenarios. Rather than implementing all components from scratch, AuRaSim builds on Blender for efficient dynamic-scene construction and Sionna RT for graphics processing unit (GPU) accelerated electromagnetic ray tracing, while introducing radar-specific adaptations for path-resolved propagation with complex coefficients, motion-aware Doppler modeling, and subsequently coherent multi-channel analog-to-digital converter (ADC) cube synthesis based on waveform configurations. Quantitative comparison between simulated and measured range-Doppler maps in digital-twin scenarios achieves a root-mean-square error (RMSE) of 0.147 and a peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 16.93 dB, demonstrating the accuracy and fidelity of the synthetic signal. AuRaSim therefore provides a complete and extensible platform for reproducible automotive radar simulation and research. Project homepage: https://wangzhaoze.github.io/aurasim.

摘要（中文）：现代仿真器能够为下游任务生成带有精确标注的合成相机和激光雷达数据。相比之下，车载雷达仿真仍不够成熟，因为它不仅需要三维引擎来对场景中的动态目标进行建模，还需要考虑电磁材料特性、天线配置、波传播机制以及相干信号合成。现有框架要么是专有的，要么过于简化，限制了雷达原始测量的可扩展性。本文提出了AuRaSim，一种基于射线追踪的车载调频连续波（FMCW）雷达仿真框架，适用于动态场景。AuRaSim并非从头实现所有组件，而是基于Blender构建高效的动态场景，并利用Sionna RT进行图形处理单元（GPU）加速的电磁射线追踪，同时引入针对雷达的特定适配，包括带复系数的路径分辨传播、运动感知多普勒建模，以及基于波形配置的相干多通道模数转换器（ADC）数据立方体合成。在数字孪生场景中，仿真与实测距离-多普勒图的定量比较实现了0.147的均方根误差（RMSE）和16.93 dB的峰值信噪比（PSNR），证明了合成信号的准确性和逼真度。因此，AuRaSim为可重复的车载雷达仿真与研究提供了一个完整且可扩展的平台。项目主页：https://wangzhaoze.github.io/aurasim。

Authors: Zhaoze Wang, Changxu Zhang, Tai Fei, Christopher Grimm, Yi Jin, Claas Tebruegge, Markus Gardill

State estimation for a hybrid rigid-continuum space manipulator system Manipulation

state estimation continuum robot factor graph GVS space manipulator

简要说明：本文提出了一种混合刚柔太空机械臂的状态估计流程，基于因子图上的MAP推断和GVS参数化，并在仿真中验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a state estimation pipeline for a hybrid rigid-continuum space manipulator, formulated as MAP inference on a factor graph with GVS-based parameterization, validated in simulation.

Abstract: Spacecraft-mounted robotic manipulators can support long-term operability of orbiting assets by conducting tasks such as on-orbit assembly, repair, upgrade, and refueling. In this context, the integration of continuum/soft robotic mechanisms into space manipulator designs promises to reduce stowage volume and mass, as well as to improve operational safety through the inherent mechanical compliance of soft structures. This work presents a novel state reconstruction pipeline for a hybrid soft-rigid space manipulator, in which the distal link is a tendon-driven continuum robot. The estimation problem is formulated as a maximum a posteriori (MAP) inference problem over the hybrid manipulator's configuration, conditioned on discrete, noisy measurements from joint encoders and a vision-based sensing pipeline. The resulting soft-constrained optimization problem is transcribed as a factor graph, providing a compact representation for fusing heterogeneous measurements with the rigid-soft kinematic model. Furthermore, the adoption of the Geometric Variable Strain (GVS) approach yields a minimum-order parameterization of the configuration, a property expected to facilitate model-based feedback control design in future work. The proposed implementation is validated in simulation on a closed-loop trajectory where, for better realism, position measurements for the continuum link are obtained by means of a simulated visual pipeline leveraging synthetic photorealistic images. The state reconstruction accuracy and computational performance confirm the potential of the proposed framework for hybrid soft-rigid robotic applications in orbit.

摘要（中文）：安装在航天器上的机械臂可以通过执行在轨装配、维修、升级和加注等任务，为轨道资产提供长期可操作性支持。在此背景下，将连续体/软体机器人机制集成到空间机械臂设计中，有望减小收纳体积和质量，并通过软体结构的固有机械柔顺性提高操作安全性。本文提出了一种针对混合软-刚体空间机械臂的新型状态重建方法，其中末端连杆为由腱驱动连续体机器人。该估计问题被表述为混合机械臂构型上的最大后验（MAP）推断问题，其条件基于关节编码器和基于视觉的传感管道提供的离散、含噪测量数据。由此产生的软约束优化问题被转化为因子图，为将异构测量数据与刚-柔运动学模型融合提供了一种紧凑表示方式。此外，采用几何变应变（GVS）方法实现了构型的最小阶参数化，这一特性预计将有助于未来工作中基于模型的反馈控制设计。所提出的实现方法在闭环轨迹上进行了仿真验证，为提高逼真度，连续体连杆的位置测量通过利用合成逼真图像的模拟视觉管道获得。状态重建精度和计算性能证实了所提出框架在轨混合软-刚体机器人应用中的潜力。

Authors: Lorenzo Ticozzi, Patricio A. Vela, Panagiotis Tsiotras

Camera-to-Quadruped Robot Pose Estimation from Sequential Images Perception3D

quadruped robot pose estimation 18-DoF pose benchmark monocular video

简要说明：提出QuadPose，一种基于单目视频的四足机器人全身18自由度姿态估计方法，并引入首个相关基准QuadSyn。该新基准上达到高精度且实时运行。

TLDR: Introduces QuadPose, a monocular video-based method for full-body 18-DoF pose estimation of quadruped robots, along with QuadSyn, the first benchmark for this task. Achieves high accuracy on the new benchmark at real-time speed.

Abstract: Quadruped robots are increasingly deployed in hazardous environments such as disaster response and facility inspection, where external-camera monitoring is essential for safe operation. This setting is challenging because quadrupeds are articulated systems with time-varying leg joints, leg symmetry, and frequent self-occlusions, which make keypoint correspondence ambiguous. Moreover, no public benchmark exists, making quantitative comparison difficult. To address these challenges, we propose QuadPose, which estimates the full-body 18-DoF pose (6-DoF base pose + 12-DoF joint angles) from monocular video sequences, and introduce QuadSyn, the first camera-to-quadruped robot pose benchmark. On QuadSyn, QuadPose achieves 92.18% PCK@2.5px, 95.54% PCK-AUC, 85.94% ADD@20cm, 66.98% ADD-AUC, and 3.65 degree mean joint-angle error at approximately 33 FPS.

摘要（中文）：四足机器人正越来越多地被部署在危险环境中，例如灾害响应和设施巡检，在这些场景中，外部摄像头监控对于安全操作至关重要。这一环境具有挑战性，因为四足机器人是带有随时间变化的腿部关节、腿部对称性以及频繁自遮挡的关节系统，这使得关键点对应关系变得模糊不清。此外，目前尚无公开基准，导致定量比较困难。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了QuadPose，它能够从单目视频序列中估计全身18自由度姿态（6自由度基座姿态+12自由度关节角度），并引入了QuadSyn，这是首个相机到四足机器人姿态基准。在QuadSyn上，QuadPose取得了92.18%的PCK@2.5px、95.54%的PCK-AUC、85.94%的ADD@20cm、66.98%的ADD-AUC，以及约33帧/秒速度下3.65度的平均关节角度误差。

Authors: Seobin Hwang, Ji-Seong Beom, Yeong-Jun Cho

Bridging Exploration and Loss of Plasticity in On-Policy Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

loss of plasticity on-policy RL PPO standard deviation robotic arm

简要说明：本文研究了在线策略强化学习中的可塑性丧失问题，重点关注PPO中策略标准差的作用，并通过在7自由度机械臂上的实际部署验证了结论。

TLDR: This paper investigates the loss of plasticity in on-policy RL, focusing on the role of policy standard deviation in PPO, and validates findings with real-world deployment on a 7-DoF robotic arm.

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms have been observed to lose the ability to adaptively learn from new data, a phenomenon termed Loss of Plasticity (LoP). While many metrics have been shown to correlate with it, the causal mechanisms and the geometric conditions from which it can arise have not been clearly identified. We analyze LoP in Proximal Policy Optimization with isotropic Gaussian policies, the state-of-the-art formulation for many continuous action spaces in RL. We report multiple metrics which characterize the effect that the policy standard deviation $σ$ has on LoP, and we also suggest related explanations for the effectiveness of widely adopted LoP mitigation techniques. We observe a significant effect of $σ$ on the extent of LoP, and accompany this with both theoretical and experimental supporting arguments. Our experimental validation consists of LoP benchmark evaluations against standard baselines as well as real-world policy deployment on a 7-DoF robotic arm.

摘要（中文）：深度强化学习算法已被观察到会丧失从新数据中进行适应性学习的能力，这一现象被称为可塑性丧失（Loss of Plasticity，简称LoP）。尽管已有许多度量指标被证明与其相关，但其因果机制及可能引发该现象的几何条件尚未被明确识别。我们针对采用各向同性高斯策略的近端策略优化（Proximal Policy Optimization）算法分析了LoP，该策略形式是强化学习中许多连续动作空间的最新表述。我们报告了多个度量指标，用以刻画策略标准差$σ$对LoP的影响，并提出了对广泛采用的LoP缓解技术有效性的相关解释。我们观察到$σ$对LoP程度具有显著影响，并辅以理论与实验两方面的支持性论证。我们的实验验证包括针对标准基准的LoP基准评估，以及在七自由度机械臂上的实际策略部署。

Authors: Andrea Vasco Grieco, Evelyn D'Elia, Edoardo Caldarelli, Raffaello Camoriano

Program-Level Adversarial Co-Adaptive Self-Play for Robotic Security Other

adversarial self-play coding agents robotic security autonomous driving humanoid locomotion

简要说明：本文提出了一个程序级对抗性共同适应自博弈框架，让编码代理为机器人软件生成攻击和防御，并在自动驾驶和人形运动上进行了验证，结果显示局部任务恢复能力，但缺乏持续的鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a framework for program-level adversarial co-adaptive self-play, where coding agents generate attacks and defenses for robotic software, demonstrated on autonomous driving and humanoid locomotion, revealing local task recovery but limited sustained robustness.

Abstract: Coding agents can adapt robotic software by revising executable programs, but successful responses to an evolving opponent may not remain effective. We present a framework for program-level adversarial co-adaptive self-play in which coding agents generate attacks and defenses from tested opponent code and mission feedback, without model fine-tuning. Environment-specific interfaces support external programs for autonomous driving and SDK-level defenses for humanoid locomotion. Two eight-generation case studies reveal concrete software responses: a driving defender introduces direct-actuation recovery, while a humanoid defender revises incoming-state validation. These responses provide local task recovery but do not establish sustained robustness. The framework makes such adaptation and limitations observable through executable artifacts and task-level evidence.

摘要（中文）：编码智能体可通过修订可执行程序来适配机器人软件，然而针对不断演化的对手所取得的成功响应未必能持续有效。我们提出了一种程序级对抗性协同自适应自博弈框架，在该框架中，编码智能体基于经过测试的对手代码与任务反馈生成攻击与防御策略，且无需模型微调。环境专属接口支持自动驾驶的外部程序以及人形运动学的SDK级防御。两项八代案例研究揭示了具体的软件响应行为：自动驾驶防御方引入了直接驱动恢复机制，而人形防御方则修正了输入状态验证逻辑。这些响应能够实现局部任务恢复，但未能建立起持续稳健性。该框架通过可执行工件与任务级证据，使此类适应过程及其局限性得以可观察化。

GCSR-OCC: Geometry Calibration and Semantic Routing for Open-Vocabulary Occupancy Prediction Perception3D

简要说明：GCSR-OCC 提出了几何校准和语义路由方法，用于从单张 RGB 图像进行开放词汇 3D 占用预测，在没有 3D 语义标注的情况下，在 Occ-ScanNet 上取得了最先进的性能。

TLDR: GCSR-OCC proposes geometry calibration and semantic routing methods for open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction from a single RGB image, achieving state-of-the-art on Occ-ScanNet without 3D semantic annotations.

Abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction represents scene geometry and semantics in a unified voxel grid, enabling recognition beyond predefined categories. One approach reconstructs scenes with 3D Gaussians and converts them into voxel occupancy. However, Gaussian scale inflation and excessive overlap can distort voxel occupancy predictions, while semantic mixing can arise within Gaussians spanning multiple categories and during 3D--2D semantic feature alignment. We propose GCSR-OCC, which combines geometry calibration and multi-mode query-conditioned semantic routing for indoor occupancy prediction from a single RGB image. The Evidence-Conserving Gaussian-to-Occupancy operator (EC-G2O) uses kernel mass normalization, $p$-norm aggregation, and a learnable gain to suppress scale inflation and excessive local evidence accumulation while calibrating occupancy responses. Multi-mode Query-First Gaussian Semantic Routing (MM-QGSR) matches multiple semantic modes per Gaussian to text queries and aggregates query-specific evidence into voxels through a learnable text-conditioned router. Fine-grained subclass queries and smoothed semantic aggregation further refine voxel-level predictions. Without 3D semantic annotations, GCSR-OCC achieves state-of-the-art performance in open-vocabulary occupancy prediction on Occ-ScanNet, with 63.31% geometric IoU and 27.44% semantic mIoU. It also reduces geometric aggregation latency from 19.76 ms to 12.88 ms. Our code will be made publicly available.

摘要（中文）：开放词汇3D占用预测在统一体素网格中表示场景几何与语义，能够识别预定义类别之外的物体。一种方法是用3D高斯重建场景并将其转换为体素占用。然而，高斯尺度膨胀和过度重叠会扭曲体素占用预测，同时跨多个类别的高斯以及在3D-2D语义特征对齐过程中可能产生语义混合问题。我们提出GCSR-OCC，结合几何校准与多模式查询条件语义路由，从单张RGB图像实现室内占用预测。证据守恒高斯到占用算子（EC-G2O）通过核质量归一化、$p$-范数聚合和可学习增益来抑制尺度膨胀和局部证据过度累积，同时校准占用响应。多模式查询优先高斯语义路由（MM-QGSR）将每个高斯的多种语义模式与文本查询匹配，并通过可学习的文本条件路由器将查询特定证据聚合到体素中。细粒度子类查询和平滑语义聚合进一步细化体素级预测。在没有3D语义标注的情况下，GCSR-OCC在Occ-ScanNet上的开放词汇占用预测中达到最先进性能，几何IoU为63.31%，语义mIoU为27.44%。同时，几何聚合延迟从19.76毫秒降至12.88毫秒。我们的代码将公开发布。
